notes.title: Hotfixes 2.3.390
notes.content: [h3]Hotfixes 2.3.390[/h3][p]- Fixed the description for the skin Carnivorous swarm larva, which can now be obtained on any difficulty level of the dungeon.[/p][p]- Fixed the display of new skins for riding animals in the character viewing window.[/p][p]- Adjusted the aggro levels of monsters and animals.[/p][p]- Increased storage space in the 'Fermentation Barrel' to 10 slots.[/p][p]- In the merchant's cellar, you can now place 2 additional 'Fermentation Barrels'.[/p][p]- Increased the drop amount of wings when skinning 'Swarm Scout', allowing you to get more than 1 piece.[/p]

notes.title: Major Update 2.3.389: The Ancient Swarm, New Bonuses, and Skills
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/14705ed38c595511d0b6ec4587e2a0e243c03592.png"][/img][/p][p]This update introduces an increase in maximum health, new skill bonuses, and improvements to the Brongart dungeon - including valuable unique rewards, a merchant, balance enhancements, and much more.[/p][p][/p][p]Get Wild Terra 2 and packs:[/p][p][url="https://wildterra2.com/"]https://wildterra2.com/[/url][/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you very much for your activity, feedback, and support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!
[/p][h2][b]Changelog for Update 2.3.389:[/b]
[/h2][h3]The Ancient Swarm and Brongart:[/h3][p]- A new NPC "Envoy of the Ancient Swarm" has been added to the Brongart dungeon, where you can purchase rare items.[/p][p]- A new exotic item, "Belt of the Ancient Swarm," has been added, featuring 3 levels of upgrades.[/p][p]- A new shrine of the Ancient Swarm has been introduced, with 2 levels of upgrades; pilgrimage to this shrine will temporarily increase your health.[/p][p]- A decorative fence set made from Ancient Swarm materials has been added.[/p][p]- Four new skins for riding animals in the style of the "Ancient Swarm" bugs have been introduced. One unique skin can be obtained by defeating the overseer of the miners, "The Chopper," on Nightmare difficulty, while the others can be purchased from the Ancient Swarm merchant.[/p][p]- A unique skin "Swarm Coordinator" for a riding animal has been added, with a chance to obtain it by defeating the Swarm Coordinator "The Hollow One" on Nightmare difficulty.[/p][p]- A new pet "Larva of the Ancient Swarm" has been added, which can be raised from an Ancient Swarm Egg.[/p][p]- A new resource type called "Biomass of Ancient Swarm Invaders" has been introduced, which is used in crafting and building.[/p][p]- Balance adjustments and changes to the number of monsters in the Brongart dungeon have been made.[/p][p]- The number of rare ore deposits in the Brongart dungeon has been increased.[/p][p]- Pathing issues in some areas of the Brongart dungeon have been fixed.[/p][p]- The rewards in the final chest of Fort Brongart have been improved (Sulfur has been added).[/p][p]- A chance to find Sulfur has been added to the loot of Fort Brongart.[/p][p]- The stack size for all body parts of the Ancient Swarm has been increased.[/p][p]- A bug causing torches to float in the air in Fort Brongart has been fixed.
[/p][h3]New Bonuses and Skills:[/h3][p]- A new bonus "Health" has been added, increasing the player's maximum health.[/p][p]- In the heavy armor set of Sangium, the "Player Protection" bonus has been replaced with the "Health" bonus.[/p][p]- Three new passive skills for Blacksmithing have been added at skill levels 40-60-65.[/p][p]- Two new passive skills and one active skill for Leatherworking have been added at skill levels 40-50-60.[/p][p]- One new active skill for Jewelcrafting has been added at skill level 50.[/p][p]- One new passive skill for Healing has been added at skill level 50.
[/p][h3]Buildings:[/h3][p]- The festive table now restores 100 of each type of satiety instead of 50.[/p][p]- The size of the Jewel Table has been fixed; it now fits exactly in 2 cells and can be placed against walls and stairs.[/p][p]- It is now possible to place iron and steel anvils on the foundation and inside rooms of the house.[/p][p]- You can now build a second floor above the Chicken Coop and Rabbit Hutch.[/p][p]- A bug that allowed placing a bed in certain areas of the PvP zone in the Valley of Ancestors has been fixed.[/p][p]- The size of the Dining Table has been adjusted, allowing it to be built near walls and foundations.[/p][p]- The planting area size of 2x2 has been fixed, so it can now be placed next to trees.[/p][p]- You can now use sturdy wood materials as fuel in the campfire.[/p][p][/p][h3]Other Changes and Fixes:[/h3][p]- The recipes for "Craft Beer 'Cherry Jubilee'" and "Dark Craft Beer 'Blue Porter'" have been modified. Tips for the new recipes can now be found in the Traveler's notes.[/p][p]- Several new notes from the Traveler's Diary have been added.[/p][p]- A bug with teleportation in the city to the "Long Ascent" has been fixed.[/p][p]- A bug in the recipe for creating the skin for the Riding Deer has been fixed.[/p][p]- The recipe for creating the skin for the Riding Bear has been changed, and a bug that affected experience gain when crafting the skin has been fixed.[/p][p]- The campfire location in Ragnara's camp has been adjusted to prevent players from getting stuck when passing between it and Ragnar.[/p][p]- A bug in the Abandoned Iron Mine has been fixed, where the exit from the mine was unavailable in some cases during room generation.[/p][p]- A bug with the spawning of objects in an inaccessible location under the tavern door has been fixed.[/p][p]- The ransom price for "Cultist Blood" from the NPC has been reduced by half.[/p]

notes.title: Update 2.3.388. Training arena, mount skins, more routes for Transporters
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/44843dbc49178e2b44b8fe441925addd93f5cc89.png[/img]

A training arena for practice fights or amateur tournaments has been added to the city, along with 15 new mount skins, new routes for Transporters, and other improvements

Get Wild Terra 2 and packs: https://wildterra2.com/

Thank you very much for your activity, feedback, and support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

[h2]Changelog for Update 2.3.388[/h2]

[h3]Training Arena:[/h3]
- A new effect "Battle Arena" has been added.
- A new area with a closed arena has been added to the city, where practice fights or amateur tournaments can take place. Near the training arena, an Arena Master has been added, allowing players to save, like at a bed.

[h3]Other changes and fixes:[/h3]
- 15 mount skins from all packs (including Zebra) have been added.
- The price for services with Transporters has been halved. Five new transport locations have been added: Long Ascent, Lumberjack Camp, Miner’s Camp, Abandoned Church, Brongart. Transport is available only in one direction and not with all Transporters.
- Five new potions for object finding have been added (Blueberry, Lingonberry, Wild Strawberry, Ramsons, Mountain Sage). The application time for all object-finding potions has been reduced to 3 seconds.
- Fixed an issue with skill book labels in containers, in the NPC purchase window, and in the exchange window between players.
- A visual display of the active state has been added for the Alchemical Cube.
- Fixed a bug with the space occupied by the Witcher's Cauldron; it now fits in 1 cell and does not block adjacent cells.
- The spawn rate of seagulls on the beach of the main continent has doubled.
- Descriptions for items that can be converted into mount skins have been updated. Additionally, the button name within the item has been updated.
- Fixed a rare bug when generating rooms in the Abandoned Iron Mine, where several iron ore deposits were inaccessible for mining.
- Fixed a bug in room generation in the Dark Forest dungeon, where some monsters appeared in inaccessible locations.
- Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented object highlighting through potions.

notes.title: Easter Event and Update 2.3.386: Mr. Bunny's Quests
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/e5f681034ac8024d7d83c3e1e3484471b92935e2.png[/img]

The Easter event has begun in the world of Wild Terra 2. Complete festive tasks from Mr. Bunny, search for Easter eggs and lost baskets, try new dishes, and treat your friends! Unique rewards await you. The event will last for 2-3 weeks, and the exact end date will be announced later.

[h3][url=https://wildterra2.com/]Get Wild Terra 2 and packs[/url][/h3]

Thank you very much for your activity, feedback, and support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

[h2]Changelog for Update 2.3.386[/h2]
[h3]Easter Event:[/h3]
- Mr. Bunny has appeared in the town, where you can take quests and purchase items.
- 5 Easter dishes have been added for restoring fullness.
- 2 Easter dishes with unique effects have been added (these dishes can be obtained as rewards for quests).
- 2 types of unique Easter eggs have been added for restoring inspiration and boosting pet experience (they can be found in Easter eggs and Easter baskets in the world).
- 6 Easter resources have been added for crafting new items and dishes.
- A separate "Easter" branch with new recipes has been added to the crafting window.
- 2 new objects, "Easter Eggs" and "Lost Easter Basket," have been added to the world, which can be found across the main continent, including its desert part.
- You can also find "Easter Eggs" near the executioner's grave in the town cemetery.
- A chain of 10 Easter quests has been added, which can be started in the town with Mr. Bunny.
- 20 daily Easter quests have been added, which can be completed after finishing the main quest chain. You will receive 2 quests per day!
- A unique mount skin, "Riding White Rabbit," has been added (available for purchase from Mr. Bunny).
- A unique backpack skin, "Easter Backpack," has been added (available for purchase from Mr. Bunny).

[h3]Mounts and Witchcraft:[/h3]
- Mounts available in the in-game shop can now be transformed into skins instead of keeping the mount. The mount itself will be lost!
- The option to create a mount skin for the Barghest in the witch's cauldron has been added.
- The drop chance for the Barghest skin from the demon in the basement has been increased from 1% to 5%.
- 5 recipes for creating basic mount skins (Goat, Boar, Deer, Wolf, Bear) have been added to the exotic item crafting system via the leatherworking skill.
- 8 new potions have been added in Witchcraft to highlight objects in the game world.
- 2 new ingredients for Witchcraft (Transmorpha Potions) can be purchased from the witch in the town.
- 5 new mount skins can be brewed in the witch's cauldron.

[h3]Other Improvements and Fixes:[/h3]
- The default quantity of items sold by all merchants is now set to 1 (as the exact amount can be specified during purchase).
- A recipe for "Glass Melting Mixture" has been added to the Pottery Machine.
- "Chitin" has been added to the armor crafting recipe for "Reinforced Leather."
- Skill books now include descriptions in inventories.
- The cooldown time for the "Absolute Protection" bonus in the "Guardian's Shield" has been increased from 40 to 50 seconds.
- A bug that prevented clay excavation from being counted in the "Buried Treasure" quest has been fixed.
- A bug causing the tutorial arrow to point to the ranged weapon button instead of the melee button has been fixed.
- The volume of heavy and very heavy footsteps from large mounts and monsters, as well as the sound of dragon wings flapping, has been reduced.

notes.title: Hotfix 2.3.384
notes.content:
- A new slow heavy bow has been added to replace the fixed composite bow.  
- New types of more powerful crossbow bolts with special effects have been added.  
- The skill requirements for top-tier light armor and light shields have been fixed to better align with equipment progression.  
- A bug has been fixed where bonuses related to the new skills Crossbows and Engineering were not included in the bonuses for Jewelcrafting.  
- The Heavy Armor skill requirements for armor made of Sangite, Zuperite, and Morbium have been corrected to better match the progression of their respective weapon types.  
- A bug with certain types of projectiles fired by monsters and pets has been fixed, causing them to sometimes miss their target.  
- A bug has been fixed where Ancient Engineer Mechanisms were not dropping in Brongart.  
- A bug has been fixed where Crossbows were categorized as Swords. Listings that were already created will need to be relisted.  
- A sound has been added for the digging animation.

notes.title: Hotfix 2.3.383
notes.content:
- The number of slots for the Large bloomery and the Large Pottery Kiln, as well as almost all ancient machines, has been increased.
- Water production in the automatic machine has been increased by 5 times.
- The number of crossbow bolts in one slot has been increased to 100.
- A bug with the number of feathers for arrows in the automatic machine has been fixed.
- The icon for the Engineering Table and the icon for the Workbench effect have been corrected.
- The number of bolts received during crafting has been increased, and even more profitable recipes have been added to the automatic machine.
- A bug with the crossbows range has been fixed.
- The position of engineering tools in hand has been corrected.
- Bugs in desert spawns have been fixed.
- A bug that caused the Protofrog pet to lack a bonus at level 40 has been fixed; it now grants an increase in the Witchery skill.
- A bug that caused the Reaper to potentially not display previously gained effects has been fixed.
- A bug that caused Crossbows to fall into the Axes category on the auction has been fixed. Listings that were already created will need to be relisted.

notes.title: Major Update 2.3.382: Engineering, Crossbows, and Free Demo
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/4d5e17ff09ef1432f765b4cdc064c73289c188a3.png[/img]
In this update, we have introduced two new skills: Crossbows and Engineering. The update also includes new pets (with the long-awaited Dalmatian!), new resources, recipes, and more than 30 other changes and fixes.

Additionally, you can now try the game for free through the demo available on the Wild Terra 2 Steam page! The demo version is limited to Starter Island and is available until you complete all quests on it.

[h2][url=https://wildterra2.com/]Get Wild Terra 2 and packs[/url][/h2]

Thank you very much for your activity, feedback, and support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

[h2]Changelog for Major Update 2.3.382[/h2]

[h3]Crossbows:[/h3]
- A new skill, Crossbows, has been added. Shots from crossbows ignore blocks and dodges, but there is a reload period after each shot. However, the low rate of fire is compensated by powerful piercing damage and new active and passive abilities. Additional damage from crossbows heavily depends on the bolts used.
- Several types of crossbows and bolts for them have been added to crafting.
[i]This is not yet the final version of the skill; we look forward to your feedback and suggestions!
[/i]
[h3]Engineering:[/h3]
- A new skill, Engineering, has been added. It allows you to build automated machines, create crossbows, and a new pet.
- A new bonus and item Engineer Tools have been introduced.
- A new crafting table and the Engineering Table effect have been added.
- 14 new resources for crafting in Engineering have been added.
- The Solution Machine has been added, allowing the production of leather solutions (4 recipes).
- Construction requirements for all machines have been updated; now the Engineering skill and additional resources are required.

[h3]Pets:[/h3]
- A Dalmatian pet has been added. This pet is included in the "Home, Sweet Home" pack. To obtain it, you need to re-enter the pack code in the server selection window. If you cannot find the code, you can contact the payment system support: https://help.xsolla.com/
- An Ancient Self-Driving Guardian pet has been added, which can be created using Engineering.
- The Reaper pet will no longer receive the attacking effect Provoke when leveling up to the maximum level.
- All pets have had bonuses for leveling Engineering and Crossbows added to their corresponding random lists.
- A bug has been fixed that caused the position of distant attack pets' targets to not be taken into account in terms of height.
- A bug has been fixed that caused pet experience information to be overlapped by the interface button.
- Minor balance changes for pets have been made.

[h3]Weapons:[/h3]
- All weapon skill categories have been divided into two tabs: melee and ranged combat.
- Plague damage has been increased for all versions of reptilian weapons.
- Reptilian weapons now have tool and crafting building requirements.
- The initial transferable versions of reptilian weapons now have production skill requirements to match the logic of obtaining other exotic weapons.
- The parameter progression for all bows has been changed, as quality material bows were underutilized.
- The amount of steel required for the composite bow has been reduced, but the amount of wood has been increased.
- When wearing a weapon and hovering over compatible equipment, the tooltip will now display total damage per second, taking into account additional damage from that equipment (for example, arrows and other projectiles).
- Some skill values for crafting plague weapons have been adjusted.

[h3]Other Innovations and Fixes:[/h3]
- A bug has been fixed that caused achievements not to be awarded on the PvE server.
- A bonus and a new passive ability for Jewelcrafting, related to the lower and upper quality limits of products, have been added.
- Pottery is now an auxiliary skill and has been moved to the corresponding section.
- A new resource, Sand Deposits, has been added to the desert region and the beach (as well as in the Naturalist Journal).
- Items "Glass Smelting Mixture," "Glass," and the ability to craft an "Empty Flask" have been added.
- The water pump now requires sand to produce water (instead of hides).
- In the pottery machine, lime and lime solution have been replaced with sand and bark solution.
- In the ammunition machine, the number of feathers needed for arrows has been reduced by 1 in all recipes.
- The number of slots in the "Trade" window between players has been increased by 5.
- The number of slots in the "Large bloomery" has been increased by 5.
- A filtering and sorting panel has been added to the "Large bloomery" and "Large pottery kiln".
- The icons for the effects "Workbench" and "Hand Mill" have been updated.
- New art for loading screens and the main menu has been added.
- Chat will now be disabled until the ship training is completed, which should help improve the situation with spam.
- A bug has been fixed that allowed the chat to create line breaks in a way that made it appear as if a different person was writing from a new line.
- A display bug has been fixed that caused the chance of taming animals to exceed 100%.
- A bug has been fixed that requires players to re-enter the game to receive purchases in the in-game shop on the PvE server.
- A bug has been fixed that caused holy swords to be visible in the equipment window.
- The correct animation for digging will now be used when harvesting clay and sand.
- The names of experience books have been fixed to fit in the trade window.

notes.title: What We Are Working On: Crossbows and Engineering
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/83a9dbab6e82338167ffcd9fc9155346d7c993a5.png[/img]

Thank you for your support and feedback!

We are working on a major update that will introduce two new skills: Engineering and Crossbows.

Engineering will allow you to create crossbows and bolts for them, as well as a Robot Pet, and it will also be necessary for crafting upgraded automated machines, taking your feedback on them into account. Like other skills, as you level up, Engineering will unlock various bonuses and useful abilities.

Crossbows are a combat skill and a new weapon. The unique feature of crossbows is that their shots ignore block and dodge, but require a reload after each shot. However, the low rate of fire is compensated by powerful penetrating damage. Additionally, you will have a choice of crossbow bolts with different characteristics.

notes.title: Update 380. Christmas event has ended, loot rights updated, inventory scaling
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/88c8b90290f1f408337dfe6ac63a6a231c189a9d.jpg[/img]

The Christmas event has ended, but you can still craft related items until January 19th. Loot rights on the PvE server are now granted to all group members. The inventory window now automatically adjusts its height. These and other changes are included in update 2.2.380.

Get Wild Terra 2 and packs: https://wildterra2.com/


Thank you very much for your activity, feedback, and support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

[h2]Changelog for Update 2.2.380[/h2]

[h3]What's New:[/h3]
- The Christmas event has concluded. All crafting related to the event will remain available until January 19.
- Loot rights and gathering on the PvE server are now permitted for all group members. The player who deals damage first is designated as the owner of the corpse. Even if they leave the group after the monster's death, they will still be able to loot it.
- The Inventory interface has been improved. The height auto-expansion feature has been adjusted based on the number of slots (to eliminate vertical scrolling).
- You can now leave the territory of any dominium via a new action. This will help prevent situations where players get trapped in another player's dominium.
- Moderators and developers can now enable the appropriate titles for their roles: Inquisitor and Creator.

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
- Fixed an issue where premium scrolls did not add time but instead overwritten it.
- Fixed an issue that allowed players to build Beds and Campfires in certain zones where it was not intended by the game.

notes.title: Update 2.2.379. Coachmans, inventory expansion, and more
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/589ae0659dc3fd2f851acac4e31ea079fca7a439.png[/img]

This update introduces Coachmans, which will help players instantly travel to desired locations (for example, to settle in the Ancestors Valley in Southern Iteria). The inventory size has been increased, new Agriculture abilities have been added, swords and Witchcraft abilities have been strengthened.

Get Wild Terra 2 and packs: [url=https://wildterra2.com/]https://wildterra2.com/[/url]

Thank you very much for your activity, feedback, and support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

[h2]Changelog for Update 2.2.379[/h2]

[h3]What's New:[/h3]
- Coachmans have been added near the tavern, in the City, and at the Port, allowing players to be transported to their desired location for a small fee. The stablehand no longer handles this.
- A Coachman has also been added in the Desert on the PvE server. Remember, you can build and set up dominiums in the Ancestors Valley in the desert, and the Coach will make this even more convenient. 
- The cost of relocation for small and medium dominiums has been reduced by 10 times.
- The inventory size has been increased by 5 slots.
- Four new passive Agriculture abilities have been added.
- Leather Belt and Hardened Leather Belt now provide 1 extra slot, allowing for 5 additional quick access slots in the early stages of the game.
- You can now hang a Christmas wreath on Marble and Castle gates.

[h3]Witchcraft:[/h3]
- The attack power and critical hit chance of Witcher swords have been increased.
- Battle Thirst is no longer interrupted by damage taken. Health consumption is reduced by half.
- Fire Blast is no longer interrupted by damage taken. Self-ignition duration has been reduced from 5 seconds to 2 seconds. Cooldown has been decreased from 30 to 25 seconds. Base damage has increased by 15%.
- Weakness: base casting speed has been reduced from 3 seconds to 2 seconds.

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
- Spawn rates for nests and ores in the plains and forests of Iteria have been increased.
- To reduce server load, the density of insignificant spawns and instant respawns has been optimized.
- The number of daily quests given by the fisherman has been reduced from 3 to 2.
- The monetary rewards for daily quests from the fisherman have been decreased, but resource rewards have been increased.
- For the active ability Gatherer’s Experience, a casting time of 4 seconds (with the option to interrupt) has been added, and the cooldown has been increased to 90 seconds.
- The progression of characteristics for the first tiers of the Miner’s Backpack is now smoother (more slots and less slowdown).
- The icon of the scroll above loading screen hints has been changed.
- Fixed invisible walls in the Echo Cave.
- Fixed an issue with an invisible wall in the swamps.
- Fixed a bug with passing through walls in the city.

notes.title: Update 2.2.378. Snow, server optimizations and fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/3a738523675c6d03ee60f5946387fa7050b444ac.jpg[/img]
In this small update, the lands of Iteria and Elyon are covered in snow, several bugs have been fixed, and improvements have been made to reduce server load.

We ask for your help in gathering spawn clusters in construction zones on the main continent, along rivers, and other dense deposits at the edges of these areas (as well as clearing them of animals).

Get Wild Terra 2 and packs: [url=https://wildterra2.com/]https://wildterra2.com/[/url]

Thank you very much for your activity, feedback, and support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

[h2]Changelog for Update 2.2.378[/h2]

[h3]Changes and Fixes:[/h3]  
- Reduced the spawn of objects on Iteria in building zones.  
- Decreased the lifespan of items dropped on the ground and open godsends.  
- Renamed server designations for better understanding of their focus: “Main Servers” and “No PvP Servers.”  
- Added snow to some territories of Elyon and Iteria, and disabled grass.  
- Fixed a bug that caused corpses to stop disappearing upon looting on PvE servers.  
- Fixed a bug where bonuses might not display in the equipment window.  
- Further increased the collider of garden plots to prevent stacking multiple plots vertically.

notes.title: Update 2.2.377. The Christmas Events Begin!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/82bed19488a1769acf1bd0fcbfacdbc4aa0cc32e.png[/img]

Krampus has returned and stolen the gifts of Iteria's inhabitants! But this is only a small part of the winter story you'll need to unravel, along with the Ragnara. Locals are reporting increasingly frequent encounters with undead who call themselves Dragon Keepers. This update brings a large amount of new content for both new and veteran players.

Also, festive items and bundles are available at a discount in the in-game store, and you can get free festive frames and icons!

Get Wild Terra 2 and packs: [url=https://wildterra2.com/]https://wildterra2.com/[/url]  

Thank you very much for your activity, feedback, and support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

[h2]Changelog for Update 2.2.377[/h2]

[h3]Christmas Event:[/h3]
- A quest chain and daily tasks have been added for Ragnara, to tell you about the ongoing events.
- A character dressed as Santa has been added to Hartfurt, selling consumables for crafting decorations for your dominion, Christmas items, and gives out a Christmas gift to anyone who asks every day!
- Portals to Krampus' Winter Forest and winter creatures are appearing throughout Iteria.

- Dragon Keepers, undead creatures, have been added and can be found in the Winter Forest, the Iterian swamp, and Plague Island.
- Skinning Dragon Keepers in the swamps have a chance to spawn a stronger monster, and at the end of the chain, you will face the key boss, the Horned Dragon.
- An Eye of the Dragon organ can drop from the servant Dragon Keepers in the winter dungeon, allowing you to summon a solo version of the Horned Dragon boss in the tavern basement. The dungeon difficulty affects the drop rate.

notes.title: What We’re Working On: PvE Server and the Fate of Legacy
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/182ac5f4bd5eedb866728464ae9bf7d0f6f87958.jpg[/img]

Thank you for your support! We have long noticed that you have shown great interest in the question of a peaceful PvE server.

[h3]We are happy to announce the launch of a PvE server in Europe! It will be available to everyone on December 6th at 1:00 PM CET.[/h3]

In connection with this event, you will receive a welcome bonus on all servers!
From now until December 16th, new characters on any server will receive a 14-day bonus of +200% experience.

[u]A few more details about PvE:[/u]
- This is a completely peaceful server with no hostile zones, no PvP damage, and no ability to loot other players' corpses.
- This server will have a separate auction.
- For the launch, we are preparing an update that will introduce mini-events, new quests, and more. This and all subsequent updates will be available on all servers.
- The new Landowner Pack will be available for purchase.
- Further content will not be focused solely on PvE; the main servers will continue to combine both aspects of the game.
- The launch of PvE servers in other regions is not currently planned.

[h3]The Fate of Legacy Servers[/h3]
We are forced to discontinue support for the Legacy servers. They were launched back when Early Access started nearly 4 years ago. The game was in its most active development phase, which resulted in various bugs (items, characters, objects, and structures). Due to these and other technical limitations, transferring anything to the new servers is impossible.

After the game was officially released, we launched the main servers, and the outdated ones received Legacy status. However, we continued to support them for another 2 years. Currently, these servers enjoy very low popularity among players, and maintaining them requires significant resources. With no other choice, we must shut down the Legacy servers on December 6, 2024.

We sincerely regret it if you have been actively playing on Legacy and will not be able to continue. We have done our best to support these servers until the end, but their time has come. We hope for your understanding.

[i](All items purchased for real money are not tied to the server, and you will be able to use them on other servers.)[/i]

We would be very happy to see you on the new servers!

notes.title: Answers to community questions #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/0dde6aacf01dccb08789f886a01215af929ed200.png[/img]

[h3]Q: Do you plan on releasing a new island think it would go over real well at expanding the game and content[/h3]

A: We would like to create a new island, but this is not possible in the near future because we would have to leave the game without any updates for several months. If we do this, we will be faced with a large outflow of audience and funding, which will be disastrous for the project. A new island means not only new territories, but also new mechanics, resources, rewards, equipment, buildings, monsters, production chains and recipes, and many other related things, the creation of which takes a lot of time. Right now we're more focused on polishing the main part of the game, but we hope that later we'll be able to return to creating large chunks of content, or releasing them in several parts.

[h3]Q: Do we get to see bug fixed and optimized gameplay response at some time ?[/h3]

A: With each update we fix many bugs and add new improvements. Over the past year, 14 updates have been released, 4 of which were major.

[h3]Q: Castle will come when?[/h3]

A: If you have an interesting idea for the mechanics of Castles, you can leave a suggestion on our discord channel.

[h3]Q: I’m also interested in whether there are plans for a port on the Nintendo Switch?[/h3]

A: No, unfortunately there will be no version for Nintendo Switch.

[h3]Q: Dear developers, I have a question about the essentially legalized use of third-party software in the game (clickers, bots) with the help of which players gain experience, for example, in healing and fishing. Don't you think that this disrupts the gameplay and gives an unreasonable advantage to these players, comparable to buying experience for these professions in the game store (p2w)? Are you going to fight the use of third-party software in the game?[/h3]

A: We point out that using this is against the rules and block players who violate these rules, as well as players who trade for real money. But while tracking bots is sometimes possible, tracking clickers is almost impossible. We are trying to combat this problem by improving mechanics, such as random spawning of monsters while fishing. We are also considering alternative options, such as introducing automatic idle fishing for everyone.

[h3]Q: When is the tavern opening?[/h3]

A: We have added this to the upcoming roadmap, now your participation in voting can affect the order in which certain things are released.

You can ask your question or suggest ideas on our Discord: https://discord.gg/62mqCkG94x

Write your new questions for the next episode!

notes.title: Update 2.2.360. Waypoints and quality of life improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/7e748f6477e5b16bfd50a048a2848defd670315e.png[/img]

[b]The Christmas event ends on January 15th![/b] Hurry up to complete related quests, make candy or decorate the walls with decorations that you can buy from the Christmas Helper in town.

In this update, we have introduced the ability for players to set a waypoint that displays the distance to the target. We have added this feature to some initial quests. Additionally, based on your feedback, we have implemented several improvements and enhancements to make it easier for players to navigate the game and interact with items.

Get Wild Terra 2 and rewards packs:
https://wildterra2.com/


Thank you very much for your activity, feedback, and support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update. 

[h2]Update 2.2.360. Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Changes and improvements:[/h3]
- Added the ability to set a waypoint with distance to the target. You can place a point with Ctrl held down both on the screen and the map. Holding down Shift while placing the pointer will memorize the distance and alert you if you stray too far, aiding in battles with mobs to maintain the required distance. You can remove the pointer with the Delete key.
- Control hints for setting waypoints have been added to the map.
- A game setting option has been added to disable on-screen indicators (including waypoints, your grave, dominium, ship, and group members).
- In the quest window, a "Show on the map" button has been added for some introductory quests, and the waypoint will be set automatically for initial quests.
- Highlighting has been added to inventory items that traders buy at an increased price during trading.
- The item search filter in the inventory now works for containers with up to 20 slots.
- The Naturalist's Journal sections Hunting and Taming now include information on the creature's category for understanding poisons and bonuses.
- The effects of Emergence and Calmness will also work on your pet when exiting dungeons in PvP zones, entering the basement tavern, or upon death in peaceful zones.
- Stack sizes for Cookies, Cinnamon baked apple, and Gingerbread Man have been increased.
- Added the ability to disassemble Santa Claus's hat.
- Stun chance has been added to the exotic club Poison strike at tiers 3 and 4.
- The Archery skill Into the eye now includes information about the critical hit multiplier.
- Reduced the requirement for killing Arctic wolves in the daily quest from Ragnara.
- Fixed an issue causing a delay and severe freeze when accessing the Witchcraft section in the naturalist's journal.
- Rectified an error in the poison charge descriptions for weapon skills that consume projectiles.
- Adjusted the groups for Seagulls, Demented Ents, and Anglermen to ensure proper functioning of attack bonuses and poisons.

notes.title: Wild Terra 2 - Roadmap 2024. Vote on development priorities
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/fdb263b8bda39256fafa6ad5a1cf410583891e1e.jpg[/img]
We decided to write about the plans in voting format so that you can influence the priority and help us understand the importance of certain innovations and better understand your expectations.

[h3]To vote, follow the link to our official Discord channel: [url=https://discord.gg/hnku276ev9]https://discord.gg/hnku276ev9[/url][/h3]

1. Improvements to the guild system and guild content (group and solo activities, ratings, scoring points with the ability to buy goods from guild NPCs, gaining experience and guild levels, bonuses and effects for members).
2. New territories (this could be an expansion of Iteria, or a new island or dungeon).
3. Group Dungeon - Boss Arena. (summoning difficult bosses to receive status rewards).
4. Tavern as a point of attraction, with social activities (perhaps from here you can quickly travel to key points, play a mini-game, or just chat/dance and get a minor temporary buff).
5. Team PvP arena (the principle of hunger games, participants are randomly distributed into two teams, with average levels of combat skills and search for equipment and weapons in the arena, and the winning players receive rating points and rewards).
6. Zone for PvP battles at any time. (special location through a guide, without the outlaw effect and without loss of equipment durability after death, you can find out which of you is cooler!).
7. New types of weapons and associated skills and abilities (two-handed and/or crossbows, etc.).
8. New combat abilities (in existing skills at high levels). 
9. Friends/enemies list (for more convenient communication, invitations, access, etc.)

notes.title: Answers to community questions #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/0dde6aacf01dccb08789f886a01215af929ed200.png[/img]

[h3]Q: How big is your Team right now?[/h3]

A: There are 5 people directly involved in the development of the game. Also, our community helps a lot with translations, testing and support. We consider you all part of the team. Thank you!

[h3]Q: Can we get a smaller more refined realistic road map?[/h3]

A: We will try to introduce a new roadmap before the end of this year.

[h3]Q: Hello everyone, how soon can we expect pvp content? Some kind of arena for training, without loss of durability, skull and satiety) Guild content, declaration of war and fights without skulls) top pvp ratings, etc.)[/h3]

A: This is quite a priority task, but for proper implementation, you first need to improve the mechanics of guilds, introduce ratings, and the PvP content system itself (battle locations, rewards, mechanics, protection against cheating, etc.). We see that many players are interested in PvP content and consider it an important part of the game. Also, we divide PvP content into solo and group, and want to offer something interesting in each category.

[h3]Q: Hi! I'll get right to the point. When will you be releasing a PvE server?[/h3]

A: Our previous experience shows that a PvE server is a bad idea for this project. Most of the mechanics lose interest or stop working, the game becomes more bland and there is a decrease in players online due to the number of servers. Instead of opening a PvE server, we want to make the experience of peaceful players more comfortable in the game in general.

[h3]Q: Which monsters all count as Mops (Bosses too)?[/h3]

A: Mobs are all creatures (including bosses) that are not NPCs, players, and their pets. We will try to provide further clarification in the naturalist's journal so that players have a better understanding of the bestiary for how bonuses and weapon poisons work.

[h3]Q: What are the plans for end game light armor? Do you have any plans to make the light armor kit more complete with something like a really good exotic light shield?[/h3]

A: You are right, the potential of light armor is not yet fully realized. But the current light shields are in some ways a placeholder. We plan to add two-handed and dual-wielding weapons to provide more options for builds, including light armor. After this, we will reconsider the role of light shields.

[h3]Q: Do you have any plan to make changes to nightmare dungeons and how they work with stun/slow/bleed/poison/etc?[/h3]

A: There are no such plans at the moment, but we are always happy to hear interesting ideas, and this may influence the plans. Now this mechanic is not done in the most interesting way.


You can ask your question or suggest ideas on our Discord: https://discord.gg/62mqCkG94x

We plan to release news in this format once every two weeks. Write your new questions!

notes.title: Major Update 2.2.357. The beginning of Christmas events!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/7284ad7e9fa0a2e3e90b73ded780837844619876.jpg[/img]

Krampus is returning, but it's just a small part of the winter story you are about to unravel, along with Ragnara. Locals say that more and more often they begin to encounter the undead who call themselves dragon keepers. In this update, we have prepared substantial content for both beginners and experienced players.

[h2][url=https://www.wildterra2.com/]Get Wild Terra 2 and rewards packs[/url][/h2]

Thank you very much for your activity, feedback, and support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

[h2]Update 2.2.357. Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Winter Forest dungeon and new monsters[/h3]
- Portals to the Krampus Winter Forest and winter beasts appear throughout Iteria.
- Demented elves can be found in the Winter forest, as well as cutting down spruces, pines, and trees of the Plague Island.
- Dragon Keepers, undead beings, have been added and can be found in the Winter forest, on the Ittiria swamp, and on the Plague Island.
- When defeating the keepers on the swamps, there is a chance of encountering a stronger monster, and at the end of the chain, a showdown with the key boss, the Horned Dragon, awaits you.
- From the servant keepers in the winter dungeon, a Dragon Eye organ may drop, allowing you to summon a solo version of the Horned Dragon boss in the tavern's basement. The likelihood of obtaining the organ depends on the dungeon's difficulty.
- In Christmas gifts, and the remains of the defeated dragon there is a chance to find a dragon egg and raise your dragon offspring!

[h3]What's new:[/h3]
- New resource gathering categories, including Gathering, Mining, and Woodcutting, have been added to the naturalist's journal.
- Junk shop Ragnara now has a quest line and daily tasks to inform you about ongoing events.
- Grey squirrels can be found in forests and fields, while polar wolves appear in PvP zones. Skinning them may open a portal to the Winter Forest.
- Christmas items have been added to loot and corpse containers.
- The recipe for crafting Christmas items and Christmas tree decorations is available again.
- Christmas presents have been introduced, offering a chance to obtain themed rewards.
- New candies have been added, and recipes for crafting staves have been modified.
- The Christmas tree recipe has changed to require yellow Christmas balls, which can be guaranteed by looting from demented elves.
- A new weapon, the Spectral spear, has been added. It doesn't consume projectiles, has durability, and is compatible with weapon poisons. It can be found in the hidden part of the Plague Island, starting from Normal difficulty, in corpse containers of the Horned and Plague Dragons.
- Iron and steel spears now have a slight armor penetration, similar to other projectiles.
- A hidden pouch with one slot has been added as a reward for early Christmas event quests.
- Thematic illustrations have been added to loading screens and the game's main menu.

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
- Fixed a resource and loot spawn error under the central tree on the cemetery.
- Corrected the issue of a low number of spawn points for Bay horses compared to Bay pinto horses; they will now appear evenly relative to each other.
- Resolved the display issue of the Transforming toxin tool in the equipment window.
- Fixed the display of the poison icon on weapons in the auction.
- Fixed mistakes in the recipes for decorative stone fences.
- Fixed a bug causing crafting speed bonuses for specific professions.
- Combined crafting speed bonuses from passive skills and dish effects.
- Adjusted the list of unlockable bonuses for the Vampire bat pet for witchcraft; the cumulative potential experience bonus chance is now +45% (previously was 30%).
- Removed mushroom identification and added the option to skip the mushroom identification quest if it is active.
- Strong Logs are now obtained from the trees on the Plague Island.
- Adjusted the attack speed of the mountain digger.
- The quest to build a Christmas tree can now be skipped (you can use a Christmas tree built during last year's events to craft items).
- Fixed icons for the pet loyalty skill and the mortar and pestle station effect.
- Corrected the incomplete display of restored pet health in the interface.
- A bug in calculating the chance for the Gathering profession bonus has been fixed.
- The bonus for the speed of applying Witchcraft abilities has been transferred from the Defensive section to the Attack.
- The problem areas with passage between houses in the city of Hartfurt have been fixed.
- The placement of the daily tasks board near the northern mountains has been a bit changed.
- We have disabled the option to create new peons, and now it is only possible to create one character. Old characters on legacy servers will remain, but you will no longer be able to create more than one character on your account.

notes.title: Update 2.2.356. The end of Halloween, the balance of Witchcraft and new fences!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/0dde6aacf01dccb08789f886a01215af929ed200.png[/img]

The Jack-monster spawn has been deactivated, and Witch's Eyes will no longer be found in discoveries and loot. Crafting of the broom mount and pumpkin lantern has been disabled. You can still cultivate pumpkins, prepare dishes, and summon the witch in the tavern basement. The blue and pink dust can now be transformed into a toxic reagent. Furthermore, we've introduced the capability to construct new varieties of walls, made substantial enhancements to the witchcraft skill upgrade system, and provided accurate details on the experience gained by pets.

Get Wild Terra 2 and rewards packs:
https://wildterra2.com/

Thank you very much for your activity, feedback, and support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

[h2]Update 2.2.356. Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Changes and improvements:[/h3]
- Construction of new types of walls made of marble and durable wood has been added.
- Castle walls with towers and stone walls have been added to the game shop.
- Jack-monster spawns have been disabled, and recipes for brooms and pumpkin lanterns have been removed.
- The witch can still be summoned in the tavern basement using the witch's eyes found during the event.
- Blue and purple dust drops and pumpkin faces for lantern creation have been removed from ominous sacks.
- Recipes for pumpkin pie and juice have been moved to the "events" subsection of cooking.
- The ability to transform blue and purple dust into a toxic reagent for witchcraft recipes has been added.
- The radius of the pumpkin lantern's effect has increased significantly.
- Basic experience for applying witchcraft combat skills has been removed; now, all skills will provide experience for targets with a 20-level difference, with an increased experience multiplier.
- Experience in skinning witchcraft organs and transforming them into a toxic reagent has been significantly increased.
- A bug that caused the attack block of witchcraft skills to give experience to light shields has been fixed. The additional experience level for successful mob blocks is now limited to level 26.
- Level requirements in recipes for crafting consumable witchcraft potions have been balanced, and increased experience in crafting potions.
- A mini-icon indicating items with quest objectives has been added.
- The placement of the "Add to blacklist" chat button has been corrected; it is now the second to last (next to the red "complain" button).
- The bug has been fixed, which allowed exploiting weaknesses, provocation, and medical skills through another target without distance verification.
- A bug with the non-pvp zone in the mountains has been fixed.
- Fixed an issue with the ability to build above the cupboard from grim wood.
- Fixed an issue with the cape clipping through the mount of the polar dragon.

[h2]Update 2.2.353. Changelog[/h2]

[h3]What's new:[/h3]
- We have added mounts, the training broomstick, and the Master's broomstick, which can only be obtained during the event!
- Junk shop Ragnara has a new questline and daily tasks to inform you about the ongoing events.
- Witch's eyes have been added to loot and containers to summon a boss in the tavern's basement.

- An ominous sack with thematic and useful rewards can be obtained from key monsters and bosses.

- A unique skin, the Usurper's cloak, has been included in the loot for the turned champion with a certain chance.

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]

- Now, after death, you can press the respawn button, and an automatic respawn will occur when the timer expires.
- Temporary invulnerability will be granted when re-entering the tavern's basement.
- Upon death in the tavern's basement, you will now appear at the entrance to the dungeon.
- Organic clots have been added from all animals, which can be combined into an organ for use in witchcraft. Additionally, the ability to combine rat tails into an organ has been added.
- Skill bonuses for witchcraft have been added to pet keepers and ruby jewelry.

- In the Orvin quest lines, the quest to build a cauldron can now be skipped, and the cauldron required for the quest can be sold for half its value.

- An error has been fixed where the incorrect chance to convert an organ into a toxin was displayed.
- Experience calculation for using witchcraft skill abilities at high levels has been corrected, significantly increasing experience gained from using the Weakness skill.
- An error causing double death sound playback after the timer expires has been fixed.
- The required level for organ gathering no longer appears in the journal if the organ can be found in a container.
- An error in displaying witchcraft swords on the back and fur on all cloaks in the equipment window has been fixed.
- The daily quest requirement for Orvin to gather stomachs has been reduced from 5 to 3.
- Descriptions of organs and their uses have been added.
- The model of the cloak awarded for killing the Cursed dwarf champion in the Tavern cellar has been corrected.
- Animal fat has been added to the recipe for the warming ointment.
- Client-server optimization has been improved for working with gifts and item disassembly.

notes.title: Major Update 350. Witchcraft, new abilities, organ harvesting, poisons and more
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/829b2d46454ae1f4f70a64f533b9913b40dabae4.png[/img]

In the central city of Iteria, the Witchcraft Master Orvin has arrived, inviting all those who wish to learn the art of harvesting organs, working with poisons, and mastering the craft of enhancing weapon properties and creating combat potions.

Among the local residents, rumors are spreading about misfortunes that have begun to occur on the Iteria with the arrival of uninvited guests. Under the cover of night, eerie screams echo from the tavern's cellar, and City Guard Sam is seeking brave volunteers ready to confront the ancient evil that is beginning to awaken…

In this update, we have prepared special content for you.

[h3]Get Wild Terra 2 and rewards packs: [url=https://www.wildterra2.com/]https://www.wildterra2.com/[/url][/h3]

Wild Terra 2 on Steam: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1134700/

Thank you very much for your activity, feedback, and support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

[h2]Update 2.2.350. Changelog[/h2]

[h3]What's new:[/h3]
- Added a new witchcraft profession, allowing the extraction and manipulation of organs.
- Added a new NPC, the witchcraft master Orvin, located in the main continent city, who trades all the necessary items for skill development.
- Added a witchcraft quest chain, immediately available and obtainable from Master Orvin.
- Added combat abilities for witchcraft, requiring the use of potions and specific equipment.
- Added the witchcrafter anklet, granting witchcraft combat abilities at half effectiveness and equipped in the left-hand weapon slot (shields).
- Added recipes for two-handed silver swords, enabling the complete realization of witchcraft skills and bonuses.
- Added the production of weapon poison. By combining different organs, you can obtain special properties and effects to enhance your weaponry.
- Added a new property, life-stealing, to weapon poison, allowing for the absorption of 10% of inflicted damage, capped at the property's value.
- Added a new effect, chilling, with gradual damage and slowing properties, which is incompatible with burning.
- Added a new ointment for chilling removal.
- Added a new dungeon-arena, the tavern basement, with boss summoning.
- Added a new quest for experienced combat players to Guard Sam, offering a unique reward.
- Added a new witchcraft section to the journal, providing information about organ properties and requirements (activity counters and bonuses will be added in next updates).
- Added a new structure, the witchcrafter cauldron, for crafting weapon poison and sacrificial organs for boss summoning.
- Organ gathering in dungeons for the witchcraft profession now begins at normal difficulty.
- Added new thematic illustrations to the main game menu and loading screens.
- Added two new auction categories: Quest Items and Organs.
- Added the sale of a pet wolf cub (previously only available through a quest) and an iron pickaxe to the miner's camp.

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
- Now, to craft more advanced medicines, a medic's workplace is required.
- A bug has been fixed that prevented settlers from entering the feudal lord's basement. Now, in the town hall settings, it's sufficient to grant access to the doors for the residents.
- A bug has been fixed where the level of summoned monsters in dungeons didn't correspond to the dungeon difficulty.
- The recipe for burn ointment has been simplified.

notes.title: Update 347. Item-based quests, chat events, exotic knife, and more improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/91ee13a18beb495d2a89cef78d2a0c6ac36d0e7b.png[/img]

In this update, we have added loot items with connected quest lines. Some are repeatable, with valuable rewards upon completion, while others allow you to obtain new items. One of these items is the exotic knife Beastmaster, which opens the ability to skin pets and begin feeding them one level earlier. Additionally, your companions have learned to steal treats from your loot, gaining experience and additional temporary effects.

Thank you very much for your activity, feedback, and support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

[h2]Update 2.2.347. Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
- Added items to loot and corpse containers that allow you to start connected repeatable quests with valuable rewards upon completion.
- Added the ability to skin pets, enabled when you equip the exotic knife "Beastmaster," which you can obtain through item-quest lines. You can still use active effects to reduce item durability consumption to avoid paying for repairs.
- Pets now have the ability to steal treats from your loot, gaining experience in the process and additional temporary effects. Added one to teach this ability to animal trainers.
- Added an option in the game settings for chat opacity.
- Added the ability to apply unstable essence to a non-transferable pet to unlock journal bonuses: feeding bonuses and reaching the maximum level (applies to pets released before the journal update  - Anglerman pet now).
- Added river fishing zones near the Forest of Futile Regrets.
- Skeleton warriors and slingers drop bones now.

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]

notes.title: Major update 345. New pets, essences of experience, journal sections, and more!
notes.content:

In this update, we have added new sections to the journal: Hunting and Taming. You can significantly strengthen your character and simplify the leveling of pets due to many unlockable bonuses now. Together, we added the alchemy ability to extract experience essences from pets. You can find new rare pets for blacksmiths and tanners from bosses.
Also, in the inventory appeared a very convenient option on all items related to crafting "Show recipe".

https://wildterra2.com/#packs-63be750abd3b08727629d9c4

[h2]Major update 2.2.345. Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
- Added new Hunting and Taming sections to the journal with information about creatures and many unlockable bonuses.
- Added a new ability in the alchemy section that opens at level 15 and allows you to extract experience essences from your pets based on their experience (the pet will be deleted).
- Empty flasks for making essences have been added to Ragnar's Junk shop for sale.
- Added new pets for the profession of blacksmith and leatherworker: Enslaved master of the mountain and Crocodile, which you can find from the relevant bosses.

- Fixed adding items to stack when vault or inventory is full.
- Fixed inaccurate display of percentages in the bonus list with fractional numbers.
- Fixed inaccurate display of record weight in the fishing journal.
- Freshness information in the journal is now displayed at the maximum possible value.
- Caught pets in the fishing and hunting journal sections will now be displayed with fear.
- Fixed a bug with the region names label popping out in the world map window when changing the width of the game screen.
- Fixed a bug with displaying pet icons with fear when container filters are active.
- Fixed a bug with item icons popping out of the inventory.
- Added description of Mining dynamite, Miners' sausage, Pet delicacy, Lucky powder, and Moonshine items used with active player skills.

- Optimized recalculation of journal-linked bonuses.

notes.title: Update 2.2.344. Journal, new abilities and improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/e01935489b72371f711a3bcce4637c91244a8d57.png[/img]

In this update, we've added a journal of activities with unlockable Fishing bonuses (now only for Fishing, but in the future for other activities), new high-level abilities for skills, and many improvements and fixes based on your feedback.

[h3][url=https://wildterra2.com/#packs-63be750abd3b08727629d9c4]Get Wild Terra 2 and rewards packs[/url][/h3]

Thank you very much for your support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

[h2]Update 2.2.344. Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Journal:[/h3]
- Added Journal, which will contain information about creatures, resources and events in the game world.
- In addition to information, the journal will record your hunting and mining progress, which will affect unlockable passive bonuses.
- Information about Fishing has been added to the journal. List of fish, number of fish caught, best records, useful information about baiting, butchering, etc.
- Various bonuses from Fishing have been added to the journal, depending on the type of fish.
*This mechanic will allow you to realize the exploring potential of the game, taking into account your personal activity progress: new bonuses, recipes and loot, and also allow you to more broadly develop new skills such as Witchcraft. At this stage, only Fishing has been added to the journal.*

[h3]New abilities:[/h3]
- Added a new bonus Double the chance of obtaining rare resources (items with a blue border and above). Each mining profession will have its own bonus!
- Added 3 new abilities for Mining (at levels 40, 50 and 60).
- Added 2 new abilities for Skinning (at level 30 and 50).
- Added 2 new abilities for Woodcutting (at levels 40 and 50).
- Added 3 new abilities for Taming (at level 60, 65 and 70).
*The following consumables will be required for active abilities.*
- Added new dishes to Cooking - Miner's sausages (level 60) and Pet delicacy (level 62).
- Added new resources to Alchemy (level 45) - Miner's Dynamite and Lucky Powder.

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
- Skinning an Ent's body now requires 55 Woodcutting, up from 50.
- Skinning the Wyrm Boss now requires skinning level 55 instead of 50.
- Passive ability icons now have a different border shape to avoid confusion with active ones.
- In the crafting window, recipes from the Exotic section have been grouped into categories for convenience.
- Now in the settings you can disable the display of flying damage and healing for yourself with a pet, for others and completely.
- Now the camera zoom when talking to NPCs can be disabled in the settings.
- Now you can adjust the price of an expired auction lot and put it back up for sale immediately without returning the items to inventory.
- An additional icon is now displayed on the icon of untamed pets for convenience.
- Now all pets with old age will display an additional icon for the item, so that you do not have to hover over the item every time and look at its age.
- Added double-click cutting of fish if it cannot be equipped.
- You can now feed roosters in the coop with barley for feathers.
- Roosters can now produce litter too.
- Added arts at loading screens for locations.
- Different arts are now displayed on the launch loading screen.
- Updated rewards for fishing quests.

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
- Fixed the sounds of bears and pets. The sound level is lowered, and attacks sound more diverse.
- Fixed stamina consumption bug when building.
- Large Mushroom Keepers and Hunters no longer appear in the Thicket Dungeon.
- Fixed a bug due to which the white halibut was not displayed in the information about the fishing zone.
- Fixed a bug due to which large fish were not displayed in the container filter and sorting did not work.
- Fixed a bug in the work of the animal perk Slow aging.
- Fixed display of action time in multiples of 60.
- Fixed a bug in the Brongart dungeon, when at the entrance the entire view was blocked by the model of the entrance itself.
- Fixed a bug with a passable wall in Brongart.
- Fixed a bug due to which the bonuses of equipped items were saved when leaving the ship.
- Fixed bugs and tooltips related to changing the fishing keys.
- Fixed a bug due to which a master's mark with plague properties could appear on weapons without plague damage.

notes.title: Welcome to the first Pet VS Pet Tournament!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/5dde2e2a6c84e933cf473eb2bbc91931d1e9cec1.png[/img]

Each server can participate but can only battle players from their server. Each player can register up to the amount of 3 pets as battle pets. ( it would be wise to talk with other players in your server and try and find players who are willing to battle your pets that have similar levels of pets) as you can only battle someone's pet if it is within 10 levels of your registered battle pets current level.

The top 3 players with the most Pet VS Pet wins will take 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place prizes for their server. To clarify, each server can get a 1st. 2nd, and 3rd place prize for their server as they will face players from their own server not other servers. We will meet in front of the church and go to a secret location for the fight to begin as to not have interference during the battle. The battles will be recorded but not live streamed as to ensure safety from sabotage. 

To register for the tournament and register your 3 pets you only have to @executioner9153 message him and communicate your registration and server and times you are free to participate. Players can not heal their pets but can use any pet they choose. There will be a tournament "wins" count that will be updated on the tournament page in the discord server so everyone can be up to date on the progress of the tournament. Video will be posted when it's done. 

[u]The date of the tournament is July 15 as start date[/u], it will end when all participants have battled their registered pets, if they cannot find someone else with a registered pet willing to fight by midnight of July 17th it is considered over and the count of wins and losses for each player will be counted. The 1st, 2nd and 3rd place prize winners will be announced Tuesday July 18th. 

[h3]The prizes for the tournament are as follows: [/h3]
[list]
[*] 3rd: cloak with a paw trace.
[*] 2nd: cloak with a paw trace + wolf hat.
[*] 1st: cloak with a paw trace + wolf hat + horse of a unique color.
[/list]

The rewards were created by the developers specifically for this tournament and their uniqueness is that they can only be received in this tournament! The developers will monitor the progress of the tournament and possibly increase the rewards or the number of prizes if there are many participants, so everyone has a chance!

Thank you all and good luck!

notes.title: The Pet Tournament starts July 15th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/6af6ac648987205f45e7ea8cc85c2744c0e65439.png[/img]
[i]This tournament is organized by the community. Organizer - [b]ExEcutioner[/b]. More details about applications, timing and other details will be announced later. Follow the news![/i]

There will be a bracket of competitors like the last tournament.

Players who take the top places will receive unique rewards created especially for this tournament! Good luck!

notes.title: Update 2.2.342. Fishing Improvement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/e01935489b72371f711a3bcce4637c91244a8d57.png[/img]

In this update, we have improved the fishing interface and divided fishing into zones: sea, river, desert, and waters inside dungeons. Fisherman Paul is ready to share his knowledge and tell everyone about fishing. New and very effective dishes, exotic items, and pets have been added to the game.

[h3][url=https://wildterra2.com/#packs-63be750abd3b08727629d9c4]Get Wild Terra 2 and rewards packs[/url][/h3]

Wild Terra 2 on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1134700/

Thank you very much for your support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!


[h2]Update 2.2.342. Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Fishing and Cooking Update:[/h3]
- Fishing interface update. Now it is easier to understand, is more visual, and contains hints.
- Fishing spots and fish species. Many new types of catch have been added. Also, they now differ in habitat zones: the sea, river, and waters inside dungeons (you will only have a few attempts to catch them during one passage). When throwing a fishing rod into the water, you will see what fish are in the pond and what used bait.
- New quests. Tasks with useful rewards and learning the basics of fishing.
- Recipe updates and new dishes with extremely beneficial effects. Lures and new baits have been added for fishing. And from the catch, in addition to updating dishes and a large amount of new food, you can craft fertilizers, ointments, and other items.
- Display of catch weight and catch records. The weight of the fish will determine its quality, cost, and amount of materials during butchering.
- Exotics and other items. Extract pearls from clams and fins of anglerfish to make exotic items with unique special bonuses.
- Added two new pets with new unique bonuses: Demented Ent and Anglerfish.
- Fish cutting has been added. In addition to components for creating items, with some fish, there is a chance to get new exotic items.
- Now you can catch a giant crab found in robbery areas.
- Increased chance of a bite.
- Updated the list of other fishing items which can be caught.
- Added more sounds to the fish reaction.

[h3]Other improvements and fixes:[/h3]
- Significantly increased the duration of the books. The effect ends regardless of whether the player is in the game.
- Fuel types in fires and stoves have been updated. You can burn strong wood and its derivatives and dark wood in large furnaces.
- Updated some icons in the skill book.
- Updated the assortment of Fisherman Paul's shop.
- Added auto-equipping tool when butchering. Added the tooltip specifies of the required tool.
- Fixed a bug that caused passive combat skill bonuses not to work if the player used an active skill.
- Fixed a bug in bat pet attack that would cause bats to knock players off their mount, and the buff effect would only give a damage penalty. Base stats of bats increased, effect time increased, and damage penalty during effect decreased.
- Increased the maximum level of the Barghest pet to 60, increased the basic stats, and added perk Rage for the last level.
- Small shellfish can now be cut.
- Wet bandages added delay for application (burn ointment is applied instantly).
- Changed fish oil recipe and reworked carp fillet recipe.
- Vegetable richness has been added to Baked ribs.
- To the dish, Baked frog legs added an effect to the gathering experience.
- Changed recipes for a campfire, based on fish fillets.
- Fixed a bug that caused fishing progress to continue if the fishing failed.
- Fixed a bug that did not reset fishing progress after death.
- Some simple tasks have been moved from the city notice board to the board at the tavern.
- Fixed some places in the dungeon Secret thicket, because of which the monsters could run out of the map.

notes.title: What we're working on: Fishing improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/d1b05afdafd833a04599a475b57097768373c65a.png[/img]

Friends! We apologize for the long silence, we had a number of moments and technical problems due to which we could not devote enough time to news and communication with you, but we did not sit idle!

- New quests. Tasks with useful rewards and learning the basics of fishing.
- Fishing areas and fish species. Many new types of catch have been added, also, they now differ in habitat zones: sea, river, there are even special creatures for dungeons (you will only have a few attempts to catch in one playthrough).
- Recipe updates and new dishes with extremely beneficial effects. Lures and new baits have been added for fishing. And from the catch, in addition to updating dishes and a large amount of new food, you can craft fertilizers, ointments and other items.
- Display of catch weight and catch records. The weight of the fish will determine its quality, the amount of materials during cutting.
- Exotic and other items. Harvest clam pearls and angler fish fins to make exotic items with special unique bonuses: New jewelry, fishing rod, belt and even pets!


Fishing improvements will appear in the game in the next update! Follow the news.

notes.title: Update 2.2.340. Carpentry improvements and Lumberjack camp, balance changes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/90f4d38e0ee674f3fcc21d0b2a168c7418026b8b.png[/img]

This update introduced new materials and recipes for carpenters, added a Lumberjack camp with quests. Increased the time before packing of dominiums, Inspiration can now be turned off with a hotkey, raw food restores up to 30 satiety, new master marks have been added, the balance of projectiles and combat skills has been changed, as well as many other improvements and fixes.

[h3][url=https://wildterra2.com/#packs-63be750abd3b08727629d9c4]Get Wild Terra 2 and rewards packs[/url][/h3]

Wild Terra 2 on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1134700/

Thank you very much for your support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!


[h2]Update 2.2.340. Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Carpentry update and Lumberjack camp:[/h3]
- Lumberjacks have set up camp in a Thicket.
- Added a line of 10 quests for the Lumberjack Camp (you can start at the carpenter in Hartfurt).
- Added 20 new daily quests in the Lumberjack Camp (will unlock after completing the main questline, 2 quests can be completed per day).

- Carpentry recipes and the amount of experience gained have been reworked, now this skill can be up to level 60.
- Added a new type of wood: Sticks / Poles / Logs of durable wood.
- Durable wood materials can now be obtained from Oaks and Spruces in the Thicket.
- A new type of processed wood from durable wood has been added to crafting.
- Updated wood resources for durable wood in some recipes (mostly starting from the iron range).

[h3]Changing projectiles and bolases:[/h3]
- Increased bolases flight speed.
- Reduced bolases creation time from 5s to 4s.
- Increased the number of bolases received at crafting from 1 to 3.
- Now the higher the level of the target, the higher the level of arrows and projectiles of thrown weapons will be required to effectively deal damage. Higher level targets take reduced damage per level (5%) and are immune to attack effects.
- Added a new type of feather: Harpy Feathers, you can get them from Harpies and their nests.
- In the recipe for crafting copper and bronze arrows, Staves were replaced with Sticks.
- In the recipe for crafting iron and steel arrows, Staves were replaced with Sticks of durable wood, and Feathers with Harpy Feathers.
- Now instead of stones, you need to create Stone shells for slings.
- The guide on Plague Island now sells bronze shells.

[h3]Combat balance changes:[/h3]
- The sling now requires two hands.
[i]The sling is too versatile a weapon with almost no downsides. We are making this change to slightly reduce the survivability of the shooters without reducing the combat characteristics of the weapon.[/i]
- Sprint ability. Effect duration 5s -> 4s. Cooldown time 20s -> 25s.
- Passive ability "Dodge Speed". Speed bonus 40% -> 50%. Effect duration 3s -> 0.3s.
[i]Light armor at a high level gave almost infinite speed up. We are reducing the overall durations, and the passive ability will be more demanding on player melee microcontrol.[/i]
- Most Heavy Shield skills now cost less stamina.
- Ability "Heavy shield strike". Stun duration 3s -> 3.5s. Damage from a weapon 10% -> 50%.
- Ability "Light shield strike". Stun duration 2s -> 1.5s. Damage from a weapon 25% -> 15%.
- Decreased the duration of skills that increase the chance of blocking with a shield, and now the bonus does not increase the block from ranged attacks. This effect does not appear in the player's bonus list.
- Ability "Backstab". Ignore absorption 100% -> 85%. Chance of bleeding 100% -> 70%. Bleed duration 8s -> 6s.
- All shields have slightly reduced Arrow Block.
- Changed the characteristics of the Target Shield.
- Bow Dark Night added absorption penetration, on tier 2 - 10%, on tier 3 - 20%, on 4 - 30%.
- Added temporary immunity to the repeated slow to Ent.
- Added temporary immunity to the repetitive stun and slow to the Plague Ogre.
- Dwarf officers and commanders have a 50% chance of temporary immunity to repeated stuns and slows.
- Added new master marks for weapons, plagued weapons have additional master marks against plague monsters.
- Now bonuses for crit chance, damage to animals or damage to insects and spiders (depending on the pet) work against pets.

[h3]Other improvements and fixes:[/h3]
- Significantly increased the time before packing dominiums when the player is inactive on new servers.
- Now you can turn inspiration on and off from the keyboard.
- Reduced max satiety recovery from raw food from 50 to 30.
- Strawberry Dessert now grants a 10% chance of doubling the loot when gathering common and uncommon resources.
- Changed the recipe for Strawberry Dessert. (10 strawberries, 2 milk, 5 sugar, red wine, bowl).
- Improved quests related to milk and strawberry desserts.
- Reduced the number of wild strawberry bushes in the world.
- Increased the harvest of strawberries from farming.
- Added Common and Advanced grindstones to crafting.
- Increased the purchase price of Special grindstones from the blacksmith from 10 to 15 silver.
- Increased the amount of experience gained when crafting materials from stone and marble.
- Increased the amount of experience gained when building from stone materials.

- Mimic pets (Crab, Squirrel, Marmot, Viper) at levels 25 and 40 have a chance to get a bonus for the Masonry skill. 
- Increased the size of the health bar of the defender critters to make them easier to catch.
- Pet perks "Agressive animals don't attack" no longer work in dungeons.
- Fixed a bug due to which defender animals sometimes did not attack the player when they appeared.
- Fixed a bug due to which the master's mark "Additional damage to bosses" did not increase the plague damage.
- Fixed a bug due to which bonuses and influence on all animals were not applied specifically to animals.
- Fixed an issue with the wolf pet perk "Wolves don't attack" that caused players to be attacked by leader wolves.
- Fixed a bug due to which animals attacked a player with the pet perk "Aggressive animals do not attack" if they could not be caught.
- Reduced Black Bear spawn time from 6 to 4 hours.

- Healing numbers are now displayed above the target.
- Added sound effects to healer skills.
- Fixed medicine error sometimes occurring when applied to a target.
- Improved kobold reward based on dungeon difficulty level, now each difficulty above "Normal" adds +1 ore slot. Nightmare will be guaranteed to drop one extra iron ore slot.
- Increased kobold health by 20 points.
- Reduced required number of monsters and resources to complete some Plague Island quests, increased gold rewards.
- Dead mages now set fire for 20 seconds instead of 5.
- Increased the amount of gold from the dead in Lasbret.
- Removed Necromancer Blood and other rare resources from Harpy loot.
- Fixed places in Brongart where it was sometimes safe to hit monsters.
- Fixed interface error when displaying a large amount of material.
- Optimized graphics for some item icons.
- Added display of fractional time in the tooltip for effects (in the skill window, at <60 seconds).
- Added description for the helmet and shield received in the tournament.
- In the crafting book, the "Bolas" category has been moved to the "Weapons" category, and "Building Kits" to "Materials".
- Fixed an issue with some loot quests where it was possible to complete a quest that required items to be handed over even if they weren't in the inventory.
- Fixed an impassable place in the rock of the Long Climb.
- Fixed a bug due to which in the large kiln, instead of logs, there were repeats of planks as fuel.
- Fixed the description of the skill "Furious Throw", indicating what the time refers to.
