notes.title: PvE team tournament is coming soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/be764a60ba174882454d0fc9fa303f4ae3bb613c.png[/img]

Welcome all to the first official cross server tournament run by ExEcutioner! (NEW SERVERS ONLY at this time.)

[h3]Registration[/h3]
To register you must have a full team of 5. To participate, just write to the Discord [b]ExEcutioner#9153 [/b]

[h3]Tournament rules[/h3]
The team leader must live stream on Twitch, YouTube or Steam. This is non negotiable. Any weapons, armor or pets are allowed.

Two teams will enter the dungeon Church on Nightmare difficulty level at the same time. Once both teams have entered the tournament will begin. Both teams have to complete the Church THREE times in a row. The team finishing with the fastest time will win. Once the tournament starts no player substitutes. No help for supplies of any kind from any players outside of the church. All teams must be registered by Friday, January 13th. 

[h3]Date and time of the event[/h3]
The tournament will be held on January 13th and 14th!
ExEcutioner is aware of the different time zones in different servers and will work closely with all team leaders to be flexible with your teams schedule. He has promised he will make this happen smoothly.

[h3]Rewards[/h3]
The winners will receive unique decor packs!

[list]
[*] 1st place. Character portraits, a golden statue to decorate the territory, a decorative helmet, a shield on the back, the title "Redeemer".
[*] 2nd place. Character portraits, a silver statue to decorate the territory, a decorative helmet.
[*] 3rd place. Character portraits, a bronze statue to decorate the territory.
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update 2.2.332. Christmas and New Year in Wild Terra 2!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/b855f9ca6c71c6b56f6a833f72bc793ba05a65fb.png[/img]

Strange rabbits and mysterious portals with bells have appeared all over Iteria. What is going on?

In the mountain gorge of the Winter Forest, the warlock Krampus and his demented elves decided to create bewitched toys - Black Rabbits (a symbol of 2023), the toys were supposed to reincarnate alive, steal Christmas gifts and naughty kids. The experiment was not entirely successful, most of the rabbits turned out to be white, some of them mutated (some of them many times), the toys refused to listen to their leader, but the warlock did not give up.
 
Krampus created portals throughout Iteria and sent rabbits to steal gifts and naughty children. The hermit Ragnara saw a portal in the forest, the elves of Krampus and his rabbits, and guessed everything. She told the residents of Hartfurt and they decided to teach Krampus a lesson by hiding branches, stones and other things that they didn’t really need under the guise of gifts. Therefore, stolen gifts can be anything!

[h2]Christmas event in Wild Terra 2![/h2]
[i]It will be held from December 15 to January 10.[/i]

[h3]Winter Forest dungeon and new monsters[/h3]
- Portals to the Krampus Winter Forest and Evil White Rabbits appear throughout Iteria.
- When skinning Evil rabbits, a Black Rabbit may appear, from which you can get Christmas balls and other holiday items. Black rabbits can have several stages, the further - the better the reward! Be careful, they can attack.
- Added a rideable Black Rabbit (can be used on the Plague Island).
- Demented elves can be found in the Winter Forest, as well as cutting down spruces and pines, bushes and stumps, as well as trees of the Plague Island.

[h3]Christmas rewards and buildings[/h3]
- Added Lost Gifts. Contain one random item (including resources, equipment, consumables, and more). If it's a quality item, then the quality will be 150!
- Added Gingerbread Man (+500 Inspiration) and Baked Cinnamon Apple (+5000 Inspiration). Can be found in loot.
- Added building a Festive table. Use with a Festive Dish to gain beneficial effects and replenish satiety.
- Added building a Christmas tree. Next to it, you can create Christmas items with useful bonuses.
- Brew candies and combine them into a sweet cane, create gifts, drink champagne and play snowballs!
- During the event, you can also get a festive cloak and a Santa hat.
[i]Ingredients for Christmas items can be found almost everywhere (godsends, chests, bosses, monster corpses).[/i]

[h3]Other improvements[/h3]
- Experience is now given when using Heal abilities.
- Now the list of attacking bonuses will also display the total damage per second, the actual damage in battle, as well as the final chance and the amount of critical damage.
- Now you can show items in chat. Drag the item into the chat window, or click on the item while holding Shift. By hovering over an item in chat, everyone will be able to see its characteristics.
- Now when you hover over the equipment, you will see a comparison with the item worn (disabled by pressing Shift).
- Now the Mill gives more flour from cereals.
- Now, when creating things, increasing the lower quality threshold above 100% will more often give a master's mark.
- A chest and a boss now always appear in the Mysterious hideout, but in addition to the Necromancer, you can also meet the Dwarf ambusher.
- Crypts now have more rooms.
- There are now more godsends in Brongart.
- Balanced prices for buying ship sets, dwarven clothes, cheese, jerky.
- Groom daily quests now give 5 cheese instead of 3.
- Increased amount of hay to feed cows from 5 to 10.
- Increased the amount of cabbage for feeding cows from 4 to 5.
- Reduced getting eggs from nests.
- Increased the production of feathers in the chicken coop from 1 to 5.
- Added raw pig meat (obtained by butchering).
- In the recipe for meat stew, cow meat is replaced with domestic pig meat.
- In the meatloaf recipe, boar meat is replaced with domestic pig meat.
- Intestines have been added to the Wild Sausage recipe.
- Increased the attack range of the Bat pet and other defender pets.
- Added more animal and monster sounds.
- Changed the sound of footsteps in the Mysterious Hideout.
- Ploughman's ability can now be used with any wine.
- Lumberjack's ability can now be used with any beer.
- Increased the minimum amount of beet seeds received.

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
- Reduced the chance of getting high level items from Harpy Nests.
- Fixed a bug due to which achievements with catching fish were sometimes not counted.
- Fixed a bug due to which crabs appeared very rarely when fishing.
- Fixed an issue where the Barghest pet's Ferocious Bite would not dismount players.
- Fixed bugs with the appearance of invisible walls in the crypts.
- Fixed a bug due to which grass began to appear around the beds when planting trees.
- Fixed display of mount effect speed for pets, taking into account open mount speed bonuses.
- Fixed a bug due to which it was possible to build too close to the cemetery.
- Fixed spawning of trees in the bandit thicket.
- Fixed requirements in Sapphire Ring recipe.
- Fixed a bug due to which at 1280x720 the duration of the effects could not be displayed.
- Fixed a bug where the sorting and filtering interface could sometimes erroneously appear on dungeon containers.
- Fixed highlighting of deposits in some quests.
- Fixed a bug due to which the ship built in the port could not be clicked with the mouse, only the hot key worked.
- Fixed a bug due to which the viper fell through the floor in the hideout.
- Fixed a bug with a non-shootable area in the crypt.
- Fixed a bug due to which Botvinia did not increase the chance of identifying godsends in dungeons.
- Fixed a bug due to which, when creating quest items, it was sometimes impossible to get a master's mark.
- Fixed inaccessible places and spawn points on Iteria and its southern part.
- Fixed blockages in Brongart so that they can only be approached from one side.

[h3]Storages:[/h3]
- Town Halls, Sheds and Chests are now divided into sections, which will help you conveniently and visually organize the storage of a large number of items.
- Increased the number of storage slots in town halls, Log shed and Log shed from grim wood.
- Added new buildings: Sheds and Chests (placed only next to the walls inside the houses), which have a large number of storage slots.
- Sheds and chests have upgrade stages (requires fewer resources and no skill level required). When upgrading, the number of sections for storage increases. Warehouses have 4 stages (log warehouse - second stage), chests - 3 stages.
- In the villa of the Merchant, the Hero (as well as under their canopies) and in the King's Tower, chests can be placed. Now these are not only decorations, but also capacious storages.
- Now, if there are items inside the building that can be lost when it is demolished, a warning will be displayed before the demolition.

[h3]Other improvements:[/h3]
- Fixed the location of pointers to the dominium and group members on the screen.
- Added "Eat All" and "Drink All" buttons for reusable auto-applying of food and drinks.
- Added sound effects and animations for the use of food, drinks and some medicines.
- Added sound effects to dagger abilities.
- Added automatic scooping of water from a well and consumption of bucket durability depending on tool bonuses. The better the type of bucket and its quality, the less durability will be consumed per application.
[i]The durability cost of buckets will not affect farming.[/i]
- Improved interface optimization.
- Reward cloak with a beetle now has 5 storage slots.
- The Ancient Underground Guardian has been weakened.
- High-level snares have increased speed and range.
- Added descriptions for some items.
- Improved the appearance of the Dragon Slayer Tower and its hiding when it overlaps the player. 
[i]Buildings inside the Tower will need to be moved in edit mode, first Climb by selecting it on the roof of the tower, and then the Stairs.[/i]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
- Fixed a bug that caused a slowdown at the entrance to the mine.
- Fixed bug with invisible walls in all dungeons.
- Now the run will not be switched by the Shift key if those windows are open where Shift is used to quickly transfer items between them.
- Fixed a bug due to which large individuals were not counted in some quests.

- Fixed spawning of resources on the edge of river banks and slightly increased fishing spots.
- Buttons have been added to the storage of personal items.

- A new attack has been added to the Valiant Knight at level 20 - Shield strike with a stun (25 second cooldown).

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]

- In the equipment window, bonuses are now sorted into categories and have priorities.
- Implemented a return to an equipped item after auto-equipping a tool when mining.
- Distributed books to city merchants, for example, a tanner sells books for the Skinning skill (in addition to nomadism), a carpenter sells books for Woodcutting, a stableman - books for Taming, a ragwoman - Healing, etc.

- Adjusted the speed of the monsters chasing the player, their attacks, various AOE attacks.
- Now monsters with ranged attacks periodically try to attack in melee.
- Identification no longer requires other skills.
- Improved lighting in Echo Cave.
- Mounts can no longer be used in dungeons.
- Added sounds during normal walking, the sounds of steps change on some surfaces.
- Added ambient sounds on the ship.
- Performed server optimization.

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
- Fixed invisible walls appearing in dungeons.
- Fixed a bug due to which items with negative effects could activate effects on monsters even on Nightmare difficulty.
- Fixed a bug due to which it was possible for some abilities to interrupt them after taking an action and not get a cooldown time.
- Fixed a bug due to which, in rare cases, resources, monsters and animals could appear outside their habitat.
- Fixed a bug due to which the color and text of the zone sometimes did not match its effects.
- Reduced the base attack speed of the Spider pet, now the attack speed bonus is unlocked at the last level.
- Fixed the display of information about the Provocation skill for a pet.
- Fixed an issue where the Plague Dragon's special attack could proc more frequently than intended.
- Temporary parts of a frame house have been removed from the list of buildings.
- Fixed a bug with rounding values ​​in the tooltip.
- Fixed a bug due to which NPC windows and containers sometimes did not close when moving.

notes.title: Update 2.2.317. Inspiration
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/1b3f2c2e8950829d76d405f191be2ae9c705c7bb.png[/img]

Added the Inspiration mechanic to help players who don't have the opportunity to play often and a lot. Also added some fixes and improvements.

Thank you very much for your support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

[h3]Update 2.1.317. Changelog[/h3]

[b]Inspiration:[/b]
- Added Inspiration mechanic. During your offline, the reservoir of inspiration will be replenished. You can use Inspiration to [b]triple the experience gained[/b] of any skill. Use the On/Off button to spend Inspiration at the right time. For all characters on the account, the reservoir of inspiration is the same.

[b]Fixes and Improvements:[/b]
- Improved and fixed a lot of little things in the introductory part of the tutorial.
- Fixed miner's food.
- Fixed quest with sulfur ore. Less ore is required and the reward has been improved.
- Fixed beer delivery quests.
- Now you can also purchase resources from the fisherman and the librarian, not only in 1 piece, but in a stack.
- Fixed the logic of the camera when interacting with NPCs.
- Fixed bug with lighting in dungeons.
- Fixed an issue where quests in the tracker could make other quests difficult to read.
- Fixed Guardian tree sapling icon.
- Slightly reduced movement speed. Adjusted animation speed.
[i]In fact, movement speed was reduced in the previous patch, but this was out of the changelog. The purpose of slowing down is to improve synchronization with the server, which will make the fight with the players more controlled, and the monsters more dangerous.[/i]

[b]Brongart dungeon changes:[/b]
- Added blockages that require Lvl 40 Woodcutting to clear.
- The spawn of finds has become more unpredictable.
- It will now be more difficult to run through the dungeon guards without engaging in battles.

notes.title: Update 2.2.316. New opening story, mining camp and animal traits!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/e9abd584a75b01f43d563c8d17a50e28e414cc69.png[/img]

In this update, we have added an introductory story and continue to rework the tutorial. The Mining Camp has also appeared in Iteria with new quests, and animals can now get unique perks! We are also preparing several cosmetic packs and decoration equip slot mechanics (will be added in the next update).

Thank you very much for your support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

[h2]Update 2.1.312. Changelog[/h2]

[h3]New tutorial:[/h3]
- Added an introductory part of the tutorial. This is a small plot story about how a character gets to Elion. (Tutorial on Elion is still in the process of being revised and will be updated later).

[i]Here it is worth making a digression about why the work on this part of the game takes a long time. In addition to the new story, quests, locations and characters, it was necessary to work out a lot of mechanics and tools that are not so noticeable to the player: displaying additional hints, changeable NPC replicas depending on events, quests with multiple tasks, automatic completion of quests where it is more convenient, special settings for the tutorial such as non-consumable stamina or disabling combat music, the mechanics of several “levels” for the minimap and icons on it, working with the camera, blocking objects of interaction until the necessary quest occurs - this is only part of the additional unnoticeable work. We will also use many of these tools in the future, for the main part of the game.[/i]

[h3]Mining camp:[/h3]
- Added a small settlement in Iteria - a mining camp. You can interact with the inhabitants of the settlement for new quests (regular and daily) and trade.
- A separate quest chain has been added (starts at the blacksmith in Hartfurt), after completing which daily quests in the camp will be available.
- Added over 20 new daily quests for miners.
- Added 2 types of unique mining food.

[h3]Animal husbandry:[/h3]
- Now, when mating and producing resources, animals will age, and when it reaches the maximum level of age, it will stop producing offspring and resources.
- Baby animal at birth now has a small chance to receive a unique bonus.
- The chance to get a unique bonus is increased if the parent also has a bonus (per each parent).
- Added more than 15 unique bonuses for each type of animal.

[h3]Improvements and other changes:[/h3]
- The display of the experience gained has become clearer (you can immediately see how much is left to the level).
- Added Acid Fertilizer and Rot Fertilizer.
- Increased the chance of getting gallbladders.
- The plague dragon now has a special area attack, be careful.
- Reworked the final room with the Beetle boss.
- Reduced the requirements to use Ploughman and Carpenter's Inspiration effects.
- The Ploughman effect now has a bonus to the speed of building beds.
- Updated graphics of the exterior of the church.
- Increased the base satiety of all raw food.
- Improved some interface elements.
- In stores, you can now buy popular goods not by 1 piece, but by a stack.

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
- Fixed a bug with the Carpenter's Inspiration effect.
- Adjusted the prices at the trader Ragnara.
- Fixed resource spawn locations in the Graveyard, Restless Gorge and Withered Canyon.
- Fixed bugs related to animal husbandry.
- Added distance check when interacting with some objects.
- Fixed resource spawn zones on Elion.
- Fixed a bug due to which the quest tracker could sometimes spontaneously collapse.
- Fixed characteristics of the first bow.
- Fixed saving effects without expiration.

notes.title: Major Update 2.1.312. Villa with wine cellar, new quests and abilities!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/211ee5e0f39570350616b0da11f7de8f2b11bf90.png[/img]

Added a prosperous merchant's villa with a wine cellar stuffed with all sorts of goodies. Lots of quest changes: new quests of increased difficulty, new daily quests and main quest chains have been added, and the rewards of the old daily quests have also been improved. Slightly buffed leader pets. Added new abilities to Axes and Healers, balanced some others. And that is not all!

Thank you very much for your support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

[h2][url=https://www.wildterra2.com/#packs-61f38fa01f02076ac0f5287a]Purchase the Merchant's pack and others[/url][/h2] 

[h3]Update 2.1.312. Changelog[/h3]

[u]Villa with a wine cellar from the Merchant's pack:[/u]
[b]Don't forget to re-enter your reward key in the main menu of the game![/b]
- A Villa with a wine cellar has been added to the Merchant's set. Descent to the cellar can be built inside the villa. If you have already built a villa, it is better to move it, sizes have changed.
- Added Wine cellar. Inside it, you can place unique buildings, as well as several barrels for fermentation and a workbench.
- Added unique merchant chest.
- Added 6 unique buildings inside the cellar, they can be built in special places. Buildings give new types of drinks and food daily.
- Added 2 unique drinks, 4 exotic fruits, 7 types of food. All of them can be obtained from the wine cellar.

[u]New quests:[/u]
- At the northern gate of Hartfurt you can meet a guard with new difficult quests.
- Added new daily quests related to animal husbandry and killing mobs.
- Added new quest chains for main quests, which can be obtained from Ragnara, animal breeder and mason.
- Improved rewards in several daily quests.

[u]Pet improvements:[/u]
- Increased the speed of leader mounts.
- Strengthened the effect of weakness on leader pets.
- Increased the health regeneration of leader pets.
- Pet skill Taunt now grants a temporary effect that reduces damage taken.
- Pet Silver Fox can now be saddled.

[u]Combat system:[/u]
[i]Technically, it is not yet possible to make instant jumps, rolls, etc. We are temporarily solving the problem with the immobility of tanks by sprint.[/i]
- Heavy shields. "Behind the Shield" Instead of slowing movement speed, it now grants a short burst of movement speed.
[i]Decided to give Axes some control against ranged targets. The penalty has been added so that in melee and multi-target combat this ability must be used with caution.
[/i]- Axes. New ability "Raging Throw". Throw an ax that stuns the target on impact and causes bleeding. After the throw, your defense is halved for a few seconds.
- Anathema axe. Increased the duration of the Bleed effect at levels 3 and 4.
[i]We add for the Healer the ability to save from death. However, we want to make it more interesting than the usual resurrection of the dead.[/i]
- Hilling. New ability "Blessing". Gives the target a 5 second effect, if the target should die during this time, then instead of dying, they will lose consciousness.
- Knives. Cunning trick. Weapon Damage 100% -> 70%.
- Knives. The Mortal Strike ability now displays the chances and amount of damage.
- The effect of poison arrows. Reduced duration 20s -> 16s.

[u]Other changes:[/u]
- In the forest dungeon, the reward has been slightly improved.
- Now you need to move far enough away from the dominium to be able to fish.
- Now clicking on an NPC will bring up a dialog box with him.
- Now clicking on a dominium stone opens its window.
- The cook's cow died and he no longer sells milk.
- In quests to kill mobs, leaders are now also taken into account.

[u]Fixes:[/u]
- The logic of demolition checks and building transfers has been improved, which will eliminate a number of errors with hanging buildings, placing one building into another, incorrect demolition, errors with hidden floors, and others.
- Fixed a bug due to which it became impossible to rotate warehouses on the spot, and put wardrobes close to each other.
- Fixed a bug due to which the Luxury Wardrobe and Luxury Dresser could be placed inside other buildings.
- Fixed a bug due to which production buildings were disabled if the character left the server and there were no other players near the building.
- Fixed a bug due to which it was possible to get stuck in the garden bed.
- Fixed a bug with displaying the quality of the offspring of animals in the auction (old animals will still be displayed).
- Fixed a bug due to which the offspring bought from the auction had the wrong quality.
- Fixed a bug with sorting pets in the inventory and warehouse. Now they are sorted along with resources.
- Fixed a bug where a black pet was summoned instead of a regular scorpion pet.
- Fixed a bug due to which targets were not highlighted in quests using skills.
- Fixed a bug due to which sometimes completing a quest would reset the open task book to the first position and change the description for the first quest.
- Optimized the display of graphics for popular buildings.

notes.title: Hotfixes 2.1.311
notes.content:

notes.title: Update 2.1.311. Placing crates on top of each other, combat balance and more
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/123c9d72e54061252205a52df4b3df0ea93cc98d.png[/img]

[h3]Update 2.1.311. Changelog[/h3]

- The White Horse in armor has been added to the King Pack. Speed 90. You must re-enter the reward key to receive.

[u]Combat system:[/u]
Light armor:
- Added a new passive ability Plasticity. While stunned, you have a chance to dodge an attack equal to half of your normal dodge.

Healing:
- Now the healer's tools, when attacking, replenish the owner's Stamina.
- Increased healing speed bonus per level 1.5% -> 2%.
- Slightly increased the healing bonus of high-level healer tools.
- Sacrifice Prayer ability. Increased the amount of health restored. Reduced the cost of stamina 30 -> 25.
- Purification ability. Reduced the cost of stamina 30 -> 25.
- Ability Knowledge of animal anatomy. Reduced cooldown 150s -> 40s.

- Light shields no longer have an attack speed penalty.
- Improved the balance of the Vampire Bat pet effect.
- Increased the stats of the Composite Bow and the Dark Night Bow.
- Mace Poison strike. Increased characteristics.
- Ability Headshot. Stun chance increased 80% -> 100%. Cast speeded up a bit.
- Ability In Twain. Slightly increased cooldown.
- Fixed a bug due to which some of the player's interruptible abilities became uninterruptible.
- Fixed a bug due to which the progress bar of interrupted abilities was not displayed. We remind you that the ability will be interrupted if you start moving.

[u]Other changes:[/u]
- Boxes can now be stacked on top of each other.
- Adjusted prices for repairing plague items.
- Fixed a bug due to which it was impossible to place ships in the port.
- Leather Strips no longer requires fat.
- Added 2 new Oiled Leather Strips recipes.
- Some crafting recipes have their regular Leather strips replaced with the new "Oiled Leather Strips".
- Incubator cycle time reduced 16 -> 12 hours.
- Accelerated growth of eggs in the incubator 20 -> 40 growth (per cycle).
- Crafting pet food no longer gives experience in Animal Husbandry.
- Added a description to the Distilled Water item to make it clear how to get it.
- Removed the requirement for Distilled Water from the Sulfur recipe in crafting.
- Reduced level requirements for Iron and Steel Maces.
- Using actions while holding down the movement key has become more convenient. The interrupted action will be canceled only when the movement key is pressed again or at mouse click.
[b]- Fixed a bug due to which even high-level animals could be caught without using snares, now it will only be possible with low-level animals. The chance to catch them without snares is greatly increased, but decreases with the level of the animal.[/b]
- Steel snare now works correctly on all leader animals.
- Fixed a bug with the display of the starter ship on Elion.
- Increased the spawn time of large bears in the thicket.
- Fixed the light on the Mining Backpack.

notes.title: Hotfixes 2.1.310
notes.content:
- The respawn time of rare resources, leaders and bosses will now be less predictable.
- Weaker versions of the Barghest and Crocodile can now be found in the Dark Forest Dungeons instead of the normal ones.
- Increased the maximum possible zoom-in on the camera.
- Significantly reduced level requirements for exotic items, as well as some axes and hammers.
- Fixed a bug due to which the attack speed was not displayed on jewelry and armor.
- Added influence of jewelry and books bonuses for Animal Husbandry.
- Added auction categories for animals and feed for the Animal Husbandry skill.
- Fixed a bug due to which the light from the backpack did not illuminate the ground.
- Fixed a bug that appeared when disconnecting from the server.
- Fixed aggro due to obstacles. Now all re-aggressions work through obstacles except for the Taunt ability. Added an explanation if the target of the Taunt was blocked by an obstacle.
- Reduced the amount of experience for cooking animal feed.
- Updated recipe "Fertilizer from bird droppings".

[i]The sling was still very strong. Slightly lowered the stats and now it takes more skill to hit with a stun, and the chance to dodge is higher.[/i]
[u]Sling:[/u]
- Slightly reduced basic attack parameters and attack speed.
- Reduced projectile range for normal attacks and abilities 15 -> 12.
- Ability Headshot. Reduced stun time 2.5s -> 2s. Casting of the ability and projectile speed are slightly slowed down.

[i]While there are no two-handed and dual weapons, we will improve light shields for a larger build options.[/i]
[u]Light shields:[/u]
- Reduced attack speed penalty 15% -> 10%.
- Increased characteristics.
- Increased the damage of Light Shield Bash ability 10% -> 25%.

- Slightly lowered the plague damage of the Morbium Warhammer.

notes.title: Major Update 2.1.309. Animal husbandry, 15 new mobs, combat balance and more
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/002b460b6a3939ec6416f72f7af6dcee795feb17.png[/img]

A new skill Animal Husbandry has been added, as well as related buildings, animals, and resources. In Iteria, added 15 new leader-animals and monsters. The battle balance has been changed, equipment level requirements have been added, and the game has become more convenient.

Thank you very much for your support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

[h2]Update 2.1.309. Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Animal husbandry:[/h3]
[i]This is the first stage of adding Animal Husbandry to the game. Later we will add new animals, as well as mechanics for breeding pets.[/i]
- A new skill Animal Husbandry has been added to the game, necessary for breeding livestock, pets and obtaining resources from it.
- In Hartfurt, you can find Ermak - a merchant selling animals and other products for Animal Husbandry.
- Added animals: Chicken, Rabbit, Pig and Cow, as well as their stages of growing up.
- Added buildings for animal husbandry: Incubator, Chicken Coop, Rabbit Coop, Pigsty and Cowshed.
- Added animals: Chicken, Rabbit, Pig and Cow, as well as their stages of growing up.
- Added buildings for animal husbandry: Incubator, Chicken Coop, Rabbit Coop, Pigsty and Cowshed.
- Depending on the gender of the animals and food, leaving the animal in it coop, you can get either a cub or resources.
- Added new resources that can be obtained from Animal Husbandry. They can be used in other recipes or sold.
- Added Hay. Can be obtained by harvesting Barley and Wheat.
- Added Animal Fat. Can be obtained by butchering domestic and wild boars and pigs.
- Added raw cow meat. Can be obtained by butchering a domestic cow.

[h3]Equipment level requirement:[/h3]
[i]Without these changes, it was possible to equip high-tier equipment on a rookie character and gain additional benefits. The cost of intermediate equipment (even of high quality) was also extremely low as it was not needed. We decided to make the leveling more consistent.[/i]
- For armor, shields, tools and weapons, the levels of the required skill have been introduced. If you equip an item with a skill requirement higher than your level, the item's stats will be lowered. The greater the difference in level, the greater the penalty.
- Improved display of information in the equipment tooltip.

[h3]Large leader-animals:[/h3]
- Added 15 new large animals and monsters of Iteria and its dungeons. Large animals are much rarer, have increased stats and rewards. Some of these animals can be tamed. 
- A new type of food has been added to crafting, which is necessary for taming some leaders.

[h3]Changes in the combat system:[/h3]
[i]In this update, we have begun combat balance changes. Under testing conditions, it is difficult to check all possible scenarios for using weapons, abilities, target characteristics and their combinations, so biases in one direction or another are likely. Also, some of the changes will be introduced sequentially. Hope for your understanding. We will continue to adjust the balance after the update.
We want the combat system to have a place for different roles and playstyles, but the Sling turned out to be too formidable weapon due to range, control and high damage with heavy crits, leaving all other weapons aside, so we decided to reduce its characteristics in several directions.[/i]
[u]Slings:[/u] 
- Changed base damage, significantly reduced critical damage.
- Spiked projectiles have reduced absorption ignore 25% <- 15%. The recipe has also been changed.
- Ability Headshot chance to stun reduced 100% <- 80%, time 3s <- 2.5s. Increased cooldown and stamina cost.
- Ability Tender Spot duration reduced 4s <- 3s.
- Exotic sling Stunishment. Stun duration reduced 3s <- 2s

[i]By mistake, we omitted the attack penalty of Morbium Heavy Shield, which resulted in the removal of the role of Tanks. Let's get the role back! Also, we are moving towards reducing the number of stuns, along with the previous changes to the sling.[/i]
[u]Shields:[/u]
- Fixed a bug due to which the heavy shield from Morbium had no attack penalty.
- Slightly increased penalty on all heavy shields.
- Slightly increased the cooldown of shield stun abilities.

[i]We are carefully starting to buff Light Armor so that it can compete with Heavy Armor. Most likely we will add new additional bonuses later.[/i]
[u]Light armor:[/u]
- Increased defense in all Light armor sets.
- Stamina savings increased 25% -> 33%.

[i]Let's move on to the roles we want to see in light armor: Knives, Bows and Healers. We increase the power of Knives and Bows, and also making the game with a bow more convenient. Healers need more serious changes later. We want to make the game for this role more interesting, and the role itself more in demand.[/i]
[u]Bows:[/u]
- Significantly reduced the time from pressing the key to the flight of the arrow. The overall rate of fire remained the same.
- Increased critical damage, changed the chances of a critical hit.
- Slightly increased the lower limit of damage. Changed the base stats of some bows.
- Ideal Position duration reduced to 10s <- 6s [i](Needed to maintain balance, especially on bosses, as damage has been increased).[/i]
[u]Knives:[/u]
- Increased critical damage.
- Backstab ability damage 100% -> 125%, added 15% defense ignore.
- Weak Spot ability damage 120% -> 150%.
- Deathly Blow ability damage 140% -> 170% [i](still has 8% chance to inflict Death Blow on 30% of the target's HP, bosses have lower chance and damage)[/i].
[u]Healing:[/u]
- Increased the spread of the bonus between the tiers of the healer's tools (the difference in the quality of the weapon should become more noticeable).
- Increased the speed bonus for Medicines activation per level.
- The power of healing pets has been reduced, but the cooldown has become faster.
- Ability Sacrificial Prayer. Reduced HP cost 30% <- 20% and healing power. Greatly reduced cooldown 15s <- 10s.
- Increased the strength of the aggro from the use of abilities. [i](needed to balance roles)[/i]

[i]Small changes to other types of weapons. More blunt damage, swords have more defense, and axes have more expensive use of a powerful ability.[/i]
[u]Blunts:[/u]
- Increased the upper limit of damage and durability.
- Reduced the cooldown of Crushing Blow 30s <- 22s.
- Increased the damage of Crushing Blow 150% -> 170%, Smithereens 100% -> 125%.
[u]Swords:[/u]
- Increased Parry bonus per level 0.3% -> 0.5%.
[u]Axes:[/u]
Ability In Twain stamina cost increased 15 -> 20.

[u]Now more comfortable:[/u]
- Objects required for quests are now highlighted in the game world to make them easier to find.
- Guild leadership can now be transferred.
- Changed the mechanism of the bonus Chance of double extraction of rare resources. Now a rare resource is any item whose rarity is: "Rare (blue border)", "Epic (purple border)" and higher. Most resources have had their Rarity parameter changed.
- Improved feedback window.

[h3]Other changes:[/h3]
- Reworked bonuses for guardian pets and base parameters for the Vampire Bat pet.
- Added a new dish "Meatloaf", which increases the experience gained for pets (10% for 10 minutes).
- Added Sticky Bomb.
- In the final chest of the Hidden Thicket, you can now find "Plague Bombs".
- The size of the Abandoned Mine has been increased, and the generation of additional forks and corridors has been added, including new ones.
- Increased the chance of Sulfur Ore spawning in coal deposits.
- Steel Pickaxe's loot modifier increased from 2.5 to 2.75.
- Increased the durability of the Steel Pickaxe from 2500 to 3000.
- Increased the chance of harvesting Jewel beetles.
- Increased the number of seeds obtained by harvesting the Onion.
- Improved some recipes.
- Updated some material and pet icons.
- Saltpeter renamed to "Compost Pit"
- Added production scheme for Bone Meal Fertilizer to the Compost Pit.
- Added production scheme for Lime Fertilizer to the Compost Pit.
- Added manure fertilizer production scheme to the Compost Pit.
- Improved blood effects.

[u]Fixes:[/u]
- Fixed several issues that caused spikes in ping on the server.
- Plague Dragon and Swamp Serpent projectiles no longer hit obstacles.
- Fixed a bug due to which the range of healing skills was not checked.
- Fixed a bug due to which the effect of the criminal was assigned to the pet, instead of its owner.
- Now if the player is at different heights with a monster that cannot reach him, the player will miss instead of hitting.
- Floors and stairs can no longer be built so that they intersect with the surface, allowing you to go inside.
- Fixed border peaceful zones where mobs from dangerous zones could spawn.
- Fixed a bug due to which it was possible to enter solo dungeons with a single entrance, with several players simulatnesly.
- Fixed a bug where a person who left a group in a dungeon could be thrown out in a state of death.
- The recipes Pink Candy and Mixed Candy have been removed from crafting.
- Fixed a bug due to which the appearance of the results of the gathering action (for example, the Harpy Chest) occurred even if the attempt was unsuccessful.
- Fixed height of plague cabinets.

notes.title: What are we working on? Animal Husbandry skill, Livestock and Pet Breeding
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/653b9b4f2a7575c08beb76445f9ea2807e62c39f.png[/img]

In the last news, we mentioned Animal Husbandry and Breeding. It's time to tell you more about the future innovation.

[h3]Livestock[/h3]
Livestock will be needed to breed animals and obtain various food and resources. They can be settled in chicken coops, various pens and houses. Will be added, for example, chicken, cow, pig and others. It will be impossible to summon and increase their level.

Livestock will have a number of parameters: gender, dominance, maturity, quality, as well as unique perks. The parameters will affect both the receipt of resources and the breeding of offspring (depending on the combination of the parameters of the parents).

The new skill Animal Husbandry will be used to raise and use livestock. As well as other skills, as the level increases, Animal Husbandry will give the owner various bonuses and abilities.

[h3]Breeding Pets[/h3]
It will be possible to get offspring not only from Livestock, but also from Pets. Leaving two different-sex individuals of the same species alone in the paddock, you can get a new pet, the abilities of which will depend on the parents (the chance of getting the ability that the parents had is higher). Perhaps we will also add new, additional perks that cubs will be able to receive.

Wild Terra 2 switched to a new version of the engine. This allowed us to fix a problem with “invisible walls”, and now new technical solutions are available for us to optimize the server and graphics, a better visual. Now you can send feedback or bug report directly from the game, by pressing F10 (the system will automatically take a screenshot).

Outwardly, nothing has changed, but on the technical side there have been major changes in almost all parts of the game, and we probably missed a few non-obvious bugs. We will follow your feedback and fix bugs on the next patch. 

Thanks a lot for your support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

notes.title: Christmas Pack and Event in Wild Terra 2! Update 2.1.298
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/c7df66329889057a419e338d57d78bba9a2dd15b.png[/img]

A Christmas event has begun in the world of Wild Terra 2! Build a Christmas tree on your territory and get Christmas items with useful bonuses! Cook candies, create gifts and meet a mad elf.

In addition to the Christmas event, new territory, monsters, buildings, pets and many other improvements have been added to the game!

[h3]Christmas pack already available:[/h3]
- Santa's bag with a cloak and extra storage slots.
- Tiger mount.
- Snowman to decorate your territory.
- Santa's lantern.
- Christmas frame and portrait of Snowman (avatar).
- 300 christmas fireworks!

[h2][url=https://www.wildterra2.com/]Buy this pack with a 20% discount[/url][/h2]

[h3]Christmas Event in Wild Terra 2![/h3]
Build a Christmas tree on your territory and create Christmas items with useful bonuses! Cook candies and combine them into a sweet cane, create gifts, and meet a mad elf chopping down spruce and pine trees. Ingredients for Christmas items can be found almost everywhere (godsends, chests, bosses, monster corpses).

[h3]New southern territory:[/h3]
- Added a new territory on the main continent, the passage to which is located next to the Cave.
- Added new monsters: scorpions, coyotes and harpies.
- Added two new pets: White Horse and Scorpion.
- Added loot objects: Harpy Nests, Graves, Finds and Dried Trees.
- In harpy nests, you can find stolen armor, weapons, and tools up to 170 quality (exclude exotic and Plague items).

[h3]Buildings:[/h3]
- Added a terrifying decor from the Plague Isle (7 types of buildings).
- Added crate from the plague wood.
- Added Dining Table.
- Added improvements to build on the table, giving various bonuses (Dinner plates and Dinner pitchers are placed only on the dining table).
- A new item "Old Cutlery" has been added to the loot.
- Added a new bonus "Food Satiety".

[h3]Improvements and other changes:[/h3]
- The time of the active lot at the auction has been increased to 96 hours.
- Added a safe zone in Plague City - Survivors' Basement.
- Increased loot in godsends on Plague Isle.
- Updated graphics for armor and weapons from Sangium.
- Updated graphics of the Lion from the Hero pack.
- Updated all outdated pet and mount icons.
- Added setting to limit the frame rate to 60, 30, or unlimited.
- Reworked sounds of animal footsteps.
- Fixed a bug due to which it was possible to build several buildings on the table in one slot.

notes.title: Reports from the devfield. What we are working on?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/30ab016716c1f882a200fb27afc504fb61aebc07.png[/img]

December turned out to be incredibly difficult for us. Over the past month, almost all of our team has been ill, and some are still ill. For a small team, this is actually a pause in development because each team member has a crucial role, and it is tough to replace him.

We planned to release an update this week that, in addition to fixes and content for the main game, would also include a Christmas event and a new pack. Due to the circumstances, the update will be released later, and a Christmas event may not come out at all if the delay is long. We hope for your understanding, and we are very sorry to leave you for the holidays without new content.

[h3]I'll tell you a little about what we are working on besides the Christmas event:[/h3]
- [b]Daily Quest Board.[/b] On every continent, a daily quest board will appear in the city - with various requests and assignments of residents, which players can complete to receive a reward. This board will first appear on Plague Isle but later on the Main Continent.
- [b]Expansion of the territory of Main Continent[/b]. One of two planned territories will be added. This is a large southern PvP zone with canyons located near the entrance to the Cave. Part of the territory will be given for construction for players, the other will be inhabited by coyotes, scorpions, and harpies, as well as new types of godsends - harpy nests and graves. The nest contains armor, weapons, and tools up to 180 quality (exclude exotic and Plague Isle items).
- [b]New constructions.[/b] Improvements for the table, giving a bonus to the upper and lower quality limits of crafted items. Ominous Plague Isle decor and storage box.
- [b]New pets[/b].
- [b]The basement of the survivors in the Plague City.[/b] A small safe area of this place.
- Reworked sounds of animal footsteps.
- Updated graphics for armor and weapons from Sangium.
- Improved the reward in the Plague Isle godsends.
- The listing of the lot at the auction is increased to 96 hours.

We will be glad if in the comments you write about what, in your opinion, should be added to the game or fixed.

notes.title: Reports from the devfield. What we are working on?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/be764a60ba174882454d0fc9fa303f4ae3bb613c.png[/img]

Hello friends! Many thanks to everyone who plays Wild Terra 2 and supports us!

We are working on a major update coming out on November 25th. Not all of the listed changes will be ready by this date, and some of them will be included in the next update.

[h3]What are we working on?[/h3]

[b]- Quests.[/b] The Plague Isle quest chain, as well as new functionality that will allow us to add new changeable quests for all continents, including the main one. Fulfilling NPC requests and orders and receiving rewards.
[b]- The final location of the Plague Isle[/b] with new monsters, a world boss and loot.
[b]- Increase in the territory of the Mainland[/b]. Two zones will be added, which will increase the continent's territory by about 40%. A significant part of these territories will be given for development (also in the PvP zone!), The other part will contain previously existing biomes, resources and opponents, but there will also be several territories with new content.
[b]- Some unpopular consumables will become more relevant[/b]. Through pleasant effects, not negative ones.
[b]- Performance improvement.[/b] Easier rendering of player buildings and some general performance improvements that can have a noticeable effect. Also, in the settings, it will be possible to limit FPS to 60 and 30.
[b]- Correction of the weather.[/b] We turn off the snow until we adjust it properly. Also, there will now be less rain and more sun.
[b]- More new sounds and music[/b]. We now have multiple battle tracks!
[b]- Bug fixes[/b]. Let's fix a lot of old ones, and add some new ones.

notes.title: Update 2.1.293. Plague Island. Part ⅠⅠ
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/5a8d4f69148178a8b1d31f2094d86a79e15a4e74.png[/img]

[h2]Changelog. Update 2.1.293[/h2]

[h3]What's new:[/h3]
- Added a solo randomly-generated dungeon. The entrance to it can be found in the Dark Forest and Swamp Marsh.
- Added new tameable pets: black wolf, bat (can be found chopping down trees on Plague Island), as well as three types of spiders.
- Godsends can now be found in locations on Plague Island.
- Large trees, deposits and monsters can be found in the Dark Forest and Swamp Marsh. They differ from general ones in their rarity, increased chance and amount of loot, as well as characteristics.
- Merchant Barney can now be found in the starting village of the island.
- Added new food and meals that can be cooked around the campfire.

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
- Reworked resource gathering timers. Now a high level of skills and the use of food will significantly affect the speed of collection.
- Increased spawn zones sizes in the Dark Forest and Swamp Marsh.
- Improved visuals of the Plague Island locations.
- Increased the visibility of ore veins on Plague Island.

[h3]Fixed bugs:[/h3]
- Fixed a bug due to which weapon strikes in some dungeons were applied to the floor surface, which caused unnecessary consumption of weapon durability.
- Fixed a bug due to which attacking mobs and pets could try to continue chasing a player instead of attacking.
- Fixed a bug due to which damage from some combat abilities could be applied to monsters with protection from usual damage.
- Fixed a bug due to which the combat abilities did not change the plague damage according to their logic.
- Fixed a bug due to which the poisonous swamp frog applied bleeding instead of poison when attacking.
- Fixed a bug due to which the special ability of a barghest was activated without needed level.
- Fixed resetting the cooldown of pets if they are pulled away before the ability is fully completed.
- Fixed a bug due to which a thrown object on the walkways in the port could not be picked up.
- Fixed display of DPS for pets.
- Fixed bugs of barghest sound effects.

notes.title: Hotfix 2.1.291
notes.content:
[b]Hotfix 2.1.291[/b]
- Significantly increased the respawn speed of all monsters and resources on the Plague Isle.
- Increased the amount of experience gained for crafting items from Plague Isle materials.
- Fixed the priority of the attacks of the Barghest pet. A ferocious bite that knocks players off a mount is now the first attack.
- When chopping trees and picking apples on the Starting Island, angry guardian animals no longer appear.
- Fixed alchemical buildings.
- Fixed a bug with an impassable place on the pier.
- Improved areas for placing ships in the port.
- Fixed a bug due to which the music of the Plague Isle could switch to the music of the continent.
- Fixed a bug due to which the player's indicator on the minimap swayed when riding some types of mounts.

We wanted to make Plague Isle dangerous and confrontational, but so that the difficulty gradually increases. Therefore, the locations are configured as follows (this is not an error):

- Plague City. You can loot the inventory of other players.

notes.title: Grand Update 2.1.290. Plague Island. Part Ⅰ
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/6018cca53a16a5da583506b18ead82f676f60a77.png[/img]

Plague Isle is available for exploration. Build your ship or buy a ticket from the captain in the Port city, go to explore new territories, get valuable resources, fighting a lot of new monsters, but be careful - these lands are saturated with death, danger, and disease!

More details about all changes are below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/89cb4f33d7c4580eb793e5982934c720d911523e.png[/img]
[h2]Changelog. Update 2.1.290[/h2]
[h3]Expeditions:[/h3]
- Added a Port City to the northeast of the Continent.
- For an expedition to the Plague Isle, you need to build your ship or use the services of other players and NPC captains. [i](For owners of the Prosperous Merchant pack, the Merchant Ship is available for building, you must re-enter the rewards key in the game menu).[/i]
- Added recipes for building ships of three tiers. Ships differ in cargo and player capacity. The resources needed to create the boat and supplies for the journey are consumed at the first construction. Upon subsequent placement of the ship, only supplies for the expedition will be consumed.
- To load/unload things on the ship, you need to contact the NPC Quartermaster.

[h3]Plague Isle:[/h3]
[i]This is the first part of the Plague Isle update. We plan to make two more parts containing new territories, a dungeon, a quest chain, more monsters and rewards, pets and mounts, different decor, and other content. Much of the above is almost ready, so the second part of the update will be available in 1-2 weeks.[/i] 

- Explore a new territory - Plague Isle. Doomed Village, Dark Forest, Viscous marshlands, and Plague City await you.
- Across the island, the effect of Acrid Air is active: you cannot use mounts from other continents, and the corpses of players and thrown objects quickly decompose. In some territories, there are other effects, we recommend paying attention to it, the island is very dangerous.
- Added disease and infection mechanics.
- Added a new type of damage and protection from it.
- More than 15 new monsters.
- Production chains, new materials obtained by mining and crafting for most professions.
- New sets of armor from Morbium metal and Leprous skin, as well as weapons of all types.
- Improved versions of warehouses and other buildings you can build from the materials of the Plague Isle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/04ddd91e47389eae4c95ccdc8dc64c25fecfebc3.png[/img]

notes.title: Plague Island. Release date and details of the great update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/84d11200cd848bb35d229bb33a7ace44875e2661.png[/img]

We continue our series of articles about seasonal continents. This time we will focus on the most important thing: what to expect from the new continent and when?

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1134700/view/2990940314658896994]Link to the previous article in the series.[/url]

[i]Remember that this is currently only a concept that may change in the future.[/i]

[h3]Plague Island[/h3]
Adventure awaits you on a gloomy island that has long been consumed by plague. Endless diseases and epidemics have left a serious imprint on the flora and fauna and the lifestyle of local residents. Staying in most areas is dangerous not only because of the starving critters and the risk of infection, but also other travelers trying to survive and get their hands on Morbium.

[h3]Morbium and other Plague Island rewards[/h3]
Morbium (Ore of the Dead) - a valuable resource with which you can endow your blade or armor plates with special properties. Equipped with morbium, you can defeat even the most powerful critters on Plague Island. You will also need this equipment on the main continent to become stronger in PvE and PvP battles. 
But Plague Island is rich not only in the Ore of the Dead, but you can also get leprous hides and organs, grim wood, spores, arsenic, and many other materials, minerals, and herbs useful for almost all professions. Use new materials to construct improved production buildings, storages, and gloomy decorations for your territory. Craft new ingredients, medicines, and equipment. Get unique pets and mounts!

[h3]Plague Island world[/h3]
Explore the Dark Forest and the dangerous Marshlands, the Plague City, with its maze of streets and large abandoned houses, many decayed corpses, and dangerous inhabitants. Get to the most distant places - Infected Bog and a new dungeon.

[h3]Plague Island release date[/h3]
This great update will be out on [u]October 14th[/u]! There will be no additional charges for content and rewards in this update.

In the next article we will tell you more about the inhabitants of the Plagued Continent, diseases, and zone rules (PvP, loot rules, etc.).

notes.title: Update 2.0.288. Master Brand, reduced repair costs and new music
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/b8f2f7cffda84d8b62114cf9b113db6d0311daf2.jpg[/img]

Added Master Brand - a random stat bonus and creator's name on high quality items. Repair costs have been significantly reduced, and the music controller has been redesigned (now the tracks also depend on situations, for example, if the character is in battle).
 
Thanks a lot for your support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

[h3]Master Brand[/h3]
– By crafting high-quality armor, weapons, and tools (which have an attack), you can endow an item with the Master Brand, which will give it an additional stat bonus and the signature of the creator's name.
–  Bonuses of the Master Brand are random, but depend on the type of item (i.e. different for light armor, heavy armor, type of weapon, etc.).

[h3]New music controller[/h3]
– Now music depends not only on the area, but also on situations (battle, home music, night, etc.)
– Several new music tracks have been added.

[h3]Other changes and bug fixes[/h3]
–  The prices for the repair of quality items have been significantly reduced.
– Fixed bugs due to which, when creating items, stamina and durability were not consumed and the skill bonus was not taken into account.
– Most equipment from loot now has more pronounced characteristics.
–  Reduced the chances of encountering guardian animals when gathering resources.
– Added game loading screen.
– The swamp and thicket zones have been slightly increased so that there are no safe zones at the edges.
– Fixed an issue that caused dungeon entrance markers to overlap player markers on the minimap.
– Fixed graphics of some sharp shores, as well as the entrance to the dungeon.

notes.title: Sailing and ships. Details about new continents
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/f7575e7f00ce0131683f4d2f37defea93e64d6fe.png[/img]

We continue our series of articles about seasonal continents. This time we will talk about ships.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1134700/view/3001072216359151729]Link to the previous article.[/url]

[i]Remember that this is currently only a concept that may change in the future.[/i]

[h3]Seaport[/h3]
In the northeast of the main continent, a port city will open its gates - the starting point for all travelers to new lands. Here you can buy or build your own ship, find merchants, repairmen, and captains of various ships.

[h3]Ships[/h3]
There are three ways to travel to a new continent:
- build or buy your own ship,
- find a place on a ship of other players (negotiate or buy),
- purchase a ticket for the ship from one of the captains (NPC).

The ships will be of different tiers - this will determine the number of seats on board, as well as the carrying capacity. The maximum number of seats on a ship is limited by the size of the group. You will be able to climb aboard and walk around the ship, adjust the color of the sails, and do other customization.

[h3]Loot transportation[/h3] 
It is better to get a ship with the maximum carrying capacity, as this will determine the number of supplies that you can take with you, as well as the amount of loot that you can bring from a new land for use or sale on the main continent.

In the next article, we'll go into more detail about the Plague land

notes.title: Plague Island. First details about new continents
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/f7575e7f00ce0131683f4d2f37defea93e64d6fe.png[/img]

We are launching a series of articles about seasonal continents in general, and about the first of them, Plague Island.
[i]Remember that this is currently only a concept that may change in the future.[/i]

[h3]What are Seasonal Continents?[/h3]
We plan to add new seasonal continents every 3-4 months. Uncharted territories with new inhabitants, changes in the rules of the game (for example, loss of items upon death, new types of damage, etc.), a campaign with a number of quests, a dungeon, as well as new resources, items, and rewards await you! We plan to keep these continents in the game forever.

Access to seasonal continents will be free! You will be able to complete the main quests and pick up rewards for this, get new resources and items. If you wish, you can purchase a [b]Battle Pass[/b] - you will unlock additional quests and the opportunity to receive unique cosmetic rewards (mounts, pets, home and territory decor, cloaks, frames, titles, etc.). The Battle Pass is only available for a limited time and will change with the launch of a new continent (regular quests and rewards can be received without time limits).

[h3]First season. Plague Island[/h3]
The first season starts this fall! Travelers will sail to the island, where they will face a long-raging plague epidemic, explore gloomy forests, swamps, abandoned villages, and will know a story of the island.

Stay tuned for more information about Plague Island, ships, and other details about Seasonal Continents.

notes.title: Major update! Healer, horses and new pets, Step 2 changes the combat system
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/dd9cdcc31df2a6fc27616ea30f2243752bd5549c.png[/img]

[h3]Major update 2.0.285 Changelog[/h3]
[i]A successful winemaker's villa with a cellar will be included in the next update.[/i]

[b]Healing skill[/b]
- Added three Healer tool sets to the recipe book.
- If the Healer's weapon is in hand, it becomes possible to use bandages, ointments and medicines on other players and pets.
- Added 6 abilities and a new Healing skill bonus.

[b]New pets and horses[/b]
- Now you have a chance to meet a small guardian animal when mining resources, but be careful, they only seem harmless in appearance. Plus you can catch them. It is with these pets that you can find bonuses to accelerated leveling to all missing crafting and exploration skills.
- Added 8 horse colors of three types of rarity to the game. Four colors can be found on the plains and in the thicket.
- Next to the tavern, the stableman Henry has settled, from whom you can buy horses of unique colors.

[b]Combat changes[/b]
- Now you can create bolases, with which you can slow down the enemy, as well as dismount players.
- Most large animals, as well as all bosses, now have a chance to dismount a player when attacking.
- Now, when riding, the defensive bonuses of dodge, parry, and block with a shield are reduced by 4 times.
- Added 3 new abilities for the Knives skill.
- Certain normal attacks and shots now consume more stamina.
- Active abilities have increased stamina cost.
- Light armor received a passive ability that reduces stamina costs.
- Fixed a bug due to which the damage bonuses for top weapons were not applied.
- Fixed a bug due to which shields did not reduce the damage done by the player.

[b]Other changes and bug fixes[/b]
- Added auto run (Caps Lock or Num Lock) similar to holding down the W button, camera rotation changes direction. Actions with chat, inventory, and interface do not disable auto run.
- A mountable pet can now be placed in a mount slot.
- Now the base speed of mounts and pets that can be mounted is displayed in the tooltip.
- Now abilities on the quick action bar that cannot be used now will look inactive.
- Fixed bugs due to which some objects entering and exiting dungeons could interfere with damage or arrows flying.
- Fixed a bug due to which bushes, low plants, mushrooms, as well as the place of death of the player could interfere with the flight of arrows or damage with weapons.
- Fixed a bug due to which a pet received experience several times if several types of periodic damage were applied on the killed mob.
- Now, if the cursor is on an ally when attacking, then the attack or shot will not be directed in his direction, but will correctly take into account the point on the surface.
- Improved the packaging of the dominium to eliminate problems with the possible situation of duplicate dominiums.
- Fixed a bug due to which the position of the auction window kept its position when updated.
- Fixed a bug due to which the abilities of thrown weapons worked incorrectly when you click them with the mouse.
- Fixed a bug due to which materials for Farming could fall into the wrong category of the auction.
- Fixed a bug due to which the inscription above the pet when hovering the cursor remained if the pet was recalled.
- Fixed a bug due to which after relocation from the island to the continent there could be an empty list of quests before the dominium was placed.
- If you notice trees outside the dominums that are not deleted or other errors related to buildings, please send a screenshot with an open debug panel (Shift + P) and hovering over the building with the mouse over the building - to the bug-report discord channel or email support@wildterra2.com. 

- The Unity developers have recognized an engine issue that is causing invisible walls in WT2. Hopefully their team will fix the bug soon. You can [url=https://issuetracker.unity3d.com/issues/navmesh-agent-can-not-pass-through-passable-area-between-carving-navmesh-obstacles]vote to solve the problem[/url] (requires a Unity account).

notes.title: Reports from the devfield. What we are working on?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/2a510fc8afa0dc7181b7d36105dea8108bc375f4.png[/img]

The next major update will be out on July 29th! We'll be adding a new support role, buff the daggers, adding a few pets and horses, balancing stamina costs, and many other changes and fixes. 

[h3]What's in the next update:[/h3]
- [b]Healing skill.[/b] You can apply bandages, ointments, and medicines to pets and other players (from a short distance), remove negative effects and sacrifice your health to save others. 6 abilities and new skill bonuses await you.
- [b]New pets and Horses[/b]. When gathering some materials and fishing, there is a chance of spawning a small angry animal (the type depends on material), which can be tamed. Also, we have added horses - you can hunt for rare horse colors and new bonuses.
- [b]Daggers and light armor.[/b] The knives will have 3 new abilities at once, which will better reveal the role of these deadly assassins. And light armor will have a passive ability to reduce stamina costs.
- [b]Stamina cost balance[/b]. All abilities, some simple hits, and defensive mechanics cost almost nothing (stamina). We want to increase the cost to make the choice of using abilities and replenishing stamina more important.
- [b]Bolases[/b]. Will be used to slow down the target and also help knock the player off the mount.
- [b]A bit about other improvements[/b]. Auto run function, the ability to equip a pet in a mount slot, a winemaker's villa, and other changes.

[i]We are also continuing to work on a new continent and more related content, but these changes will appear in the game at a later date.[/i]

notes.title: Reports from the devfield. What we are working on?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/2cfb5753c3e2d68f597e9b50bfb1a2cda739f519.png[/img]

Right now we are actively working in several areas at once:
- [b]New continent[/b]. The general concept of gameplay, locations, and new mechanics has already been worked out. Work is underway on the design of the territories. I can't wait to tell you about it, but more on that later, when there are more details and screenshots!
- [b]Support role[/b]. We are working to develop Healing into a profession used in battle, with a unique tool of this profession. You can apply bandages, ointments, and medicines to pets and other players, free allies from negative effects and sacrifice your health to save others. This will not feel like a classic caster-healer, but more like a more realistic doctor from the battlefield.
- [b]New tameable animals[/b]. We made sure that during the extraction of resources and fishing there was a rare chance of the appearance of a small formidable animal (be careful with it!), which can be tamed.
- [b]Horses[/b]. We have added horses - they become mounts immediately after taming and are equipped in the mount slot.

notes.title: Update 2.0.284. Battle axes and daggers, auction fixes, more time for dominiums
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/91ee13a18beb495d2a89cef78d2a0c6ac36d0e7b.png[/img]

In this update, we have improved the auction, added battle axes and daggers, a special pack of rewards for streamers, extended the duration of dominiums, and other changes!

[h3]Changelog. Update 2.0.284[/h3]

A special pack of rewards for streamers has been added!

[b]Auction:[/b]
- Added section for belts.
- Now at the auction, tamed pets will have their level displayed in the name.
- Fixed a bug due to which some items were in the wrong categories of the auction. The fix will only affect new lots, and old products may fall into the wrong category. We recommend that you cancel the current lots in order to be placed in the correct category.
- Improved lot statuses for better seller convenience.
- Now for items that cannot be sold, a message is displayed when you try to put them up for auction or put them in a merchant's window.
- Fixed a bug due to which the auction buttons did not work after restarting the game server.
- Fixed a bug due to which it was possible to get to non-existent auction pages.
- Fixed a bug due to which the font in the money input fields could disappear at some resolutions and interface scaling settings.
- Fixed a bug due to which the cost of an instant purchase was not displayed in the tab of your lots if a bid was made on the item.

[b]Axes and daggers:[/b]
- Added iron and steel battle axes and daggers.
- Lumberjack's iron and steel hatchets, as well as hunting knives now have lower damage indicators.
- Battle axes (including Anathema) and daggers can now be used for loot, but have worse bonuses for this.
- Executioner axe, Sangium and Zuperium axes are slightly strengthened.
- Replaced some weapon models.
These are not final changes for the Knives. In the future, we plan to revise their balance and add more active and passive abilities.

[b]For beginners:[/b]
- The character now eats simple raw food faster.
- Increased the combat characteristics of the Stone Knife, Skeleton Sword.
- Instead of rags, new base rings and amulets can now be found in loot and godsends.
- Reduced skill requirement for crafting a Wooden Shield. The quest now requires blocking 50 damage instead of 100.

[b]Other changes:[/b]
- The time before packing dominiums in the absence of the owner is increased to 5-10-15 days.
- Now you can buy the Postponement Deed from the librarian, which gives you the opportunity to be out of the game for up to 30 days and not be afraid that your dominium will be automatically packed due to your absence.
- Now if the animal is locked in the dominium, it will start to panic and die, unable to withstand life in captivity. There will be no loot in the carcass of such an animal.
- The combat characteristics of the Wonderful Tool have been slightly reduced.
- In the crafting book, the categories of some weapons have been changed for more convenient navigation.
- Updated sword icons.
- Increased bonuses from food on the speed of creation, collection, and the number of materials received.
- By double-clicking on an untamed pet in the inventory, an attempt is now made to feed it.
- Slightly reduced chance of finding beetles. Increased chance of catching small shellfish.
- Improved the logic of separating items with held-down Ctrl when moving them into a container and on top of each other.

[b]Fixed bugs:[/b]
- Fixed a critical bug that caused weapons with no quality stats to always do the lower damage limit.
- Fixed the sound of the mill.
- Now the missing items from the inventory that is out of the number of slots or overlapped in case of errors will appear in free slots.
- Now all items that cannot be sold, transferred, or put out have a corresponding mark. Fixed the message for such items that can only be placed in the warehouse of the town hall.
- The description of an untamed pet no longer displays the casting time of its summon.
- During a storm, it is now significantly lighter.

notes.title: Major Update 2.0.281. Auction, levels of exotic items, improvement of Crypts
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/44cc4dba17686d9746a648fabb7329c9632891ce.png[/img]

Added Auction - send goods for sale, place bids, buy items even from other servers! Exotic items now have upgrade levels instead of quality. Crypts on the graveyard are now created by randomly generating rooms, a new boss has been added, as well as godsends that require the Identification skill. A new farmer trader, increased convenience when crafting a large number of items and its division into stacks, and much more awaits you!

[h2]Changelog. Update 2.0.281[/h2]

- Added Korean, but translation is not complete. We remind you that the game is translated by our community. If you would like to help translate the game into your native language, please email us at support@wildterra2.com.

[h3]Auction[/h3]
[i]To ensure that the Auction does not completely replace ordinary trade, communication, competition on one server remains - we have set a time limit on bids, as well as commissions: 10% from the seller when selling any item, as well as an additional 10% from the [u]buyer[/u] when trading overseas (buying from another server).
[/i]
- Auction has been added to the game. To access it, you need to build the Auction House. List goods for sale, place bids, buy things even from other servers!
- Available search and sorting by various filters (quality, item type, etc.).
- We will continue to improve the usability, functionality, and interface of the Auction in the next updates.

[h3]Exotic item levels[/h3]
[i]Through your testing, we realized that exotic items were giving too much of an advantage over the difficulty of creating them. We decided to make its creation difficult and interesting, and the characteristics more controllable, removing the quality. It will be much more difficult to get the maximum level, but the characteristics of such an item will exceed the previous 160 quality exotics. We had to make a difficult decision regarding the already created items in the game - they will all get level 1. We are sincerely sorry for the effort the players put in to achieve maximum quality, but this is the best option to keep developing and testing. The game is in early access, evolving, and many things cannot remain unchanged, and changes sometimes require losses.[/i]

- Exotic items now have 4 upgrade levels and have no quality. As the level increases, characteristics increase, visual effects are added.
- All current exotic items will get 1st level.
- Items of levels 3 and 4 cannot be transferred or lost, but its creation does not have level requirements.
- Added more than 20 new recipes and materials that will be required to upgrade levels 3 and 4.

[h3]Updated Crypts[/h3]
- Crypts on the graveyard now have a random generation of rooms, enemies, and rewards.
- Added godsends requiring the Identification skill.
- Added a new boss!
- The entrance to the crypts is now highlighted.
- Added crypt minimap.

[h3]Other changes and improvements[/h3]
- Some city merchants are now in houses. Added interiors of such rooms.
- Added new trader Farmer Jack.
- Added a button in the crafting window to create the maximum number of items until the resources run out.
- Added division by exact amount when dragging items while holding down Ctrl.
- Added the ability to go to the recipe in the repair window.
- Selling ready meals and alcohol to the Chef is now more profitable.
- Added gatherable stumps, snags, and bushes. There are no more non-removable snags and other similar obstacles.
- It is no longer possible to commit suicide in the safe zone in front of the mountain fortress.
- Added new sounds: windmill, Taunt ability, swamp creatures.

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed a bug due to which the summoned pet could appear on the back of the wall from the player.
- Tall towers now hide when overlapping your character.
- Fixed some bugs with the repair window.
- Unrecognized items can no longer be sold.
- Fixed a bug due to which the server checks of the dominium zone and zones of no construction when moving and unpacking buildings did not work.
- Fixed a bug when pressing the "V" button that did not start the creation of an item if the text field with the quantity was active.
- Fixed window shaking error when scaling the interface.
- Fixed a bug due to which the double experience was not given to Pottery when using amethyst jewelry.
- Fixed bug with sticky icons when dragging with the mouse.
- Fixed a bug with darkened icons if you close the container window while dragging.
- Fixed a bug due to which Esc did not close the repair window.
- Fixed a bug due to which the information of requirements and materials in the repair window was not updated.
- Fixed a bug due to which Hit with a Heavy Shield would provoke the target even without hitting it.

notes.title: Update is delayed
notes.content:
Friends,

We understand that you are upset and have been waiting for a patch with an auction, exotic levels, upgraded crypts, and other innovations for a long time. However, the illness of our team members completely disrupted our plans.

During the work on this update, half of us have already got sick. I am still ill, and with the coronavirus, it is pretty difficult to predict the timing of recovery, but we are already in the last stages of work on the update and plan to release it in the first half of next week. Hope for your understanding. We wish you and the health of your loved ones!

notes.title: Reports from the devfield. What we are working on?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/96ddfe0a8d0d608487c3030e0280478bb9196faa.jpg[/img]

The next major update was planned for May 27, but we have to postpone it for 1-2 weeks. There is always a possibility that the deadlines will be shifted for a small team if one of the developers is temporarily unable to work (illness, relocation, and other circumstances). Hope for your understanding.

[h3]What's will be included in this update:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Auction.[/b] Build an auction house, and you can sell and buy goods without leaving your territory, as well as be able to trade with players from other servers.
[i]We do not want the cross-server auction to be a complete replacement for the current trading through chat and meeting players in the game world. Therefore, when selling through the auction, the seller pays a 10% commission (in addition, the buyer will also pay a 5% commission if this purchase was cross-server).[/i]
[*] [b]Updated Crypts[/b]. Crypts will become more interesting and will receive a random generation of rooms, enemies, and rewards. A new boss will also added!
[*] [b]Exotic item levels[/b]. Each exotic item will have 4 upgrade levels instead of quality [i](all exotic items created before this update will receive 1 level)[/i]. The maximum, 4th level will roughly correspond to the quality of 185%!, and also will have visual effects.  About 15 materials and recipes will be added to improve to the last two levels, which will solve several problems at once:
 - fill in the missing places in skill leveling,
 - a significant part of the materials can be found when collecting low-level resources - this will open up new ways of earning for beginners,
 - players will leave dungeons more often because recipes will contain materials from outdoor bosses.
[*] [b]Stumps, snags, and bushes will be gathered[/b]. Now, this does not interfere with construction, and new models will make the game world a little more diverse.
[*] [b]Usability improvements and bug fixes[/b]. Added a button for creating Maximum items, the ability to go to the recipe in the repair window, fixed errors with the interface, and other fixes.
[/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/ce4c1dc38ab1406ce3384ae8b8ba8e0110e2c91c.png[/img]

In this update, we focused on fixing a number of bugs and inconveniences. The next update will contain more content, details in next week's announcement!
