notes.title: Major Update 2.0.277. Difficulty levels, new randomized dungeons, and more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/f21086a89cafc50a8524a5646bc3d0d9f410fe2d.png[/img]

In this update, we've added a choice of difficulty when entering dungeons, new randomized dungeons for solo players, a system for reporting intruders, and many other improvements and fixes.

[h3]Changelog. Update 2.0.277[/h3]

[b]Difficulty levels:[/b]
- Before entering any dungeon, you can now choose one of five difficulty levels. The harder it is, the higher the rewards and levels of opponents!

[b]Dungeons for solo players:[/b]
- [u]Mines[/u]. Randomly generated dungeons for iron mining. Here you can meet new opponents: Infected Bat, Cave Spider, Insidious Kobold. The entrance is always located in one place.
- [u]Mysterious hideout[/u]. A randomly generated dungeon, the entrance to which can be found at random locations on the Continent. Godsends, scraps, bosses and treasures are a real adventure!

[b]Reporting system:[/b]
- If you meet an offender in the game world or in the chat, you can inform us about him by selecting the appropriate category: “Cheats / Using bugs”, “Bot program”, “Real money trading”, “Insults, excessive abuse”. This will help to better counteract violators and apply penalties.

[b]Changing bows and sling:[/b]
- Added modifiers for armor penetration by projectiles.
- Reduced the cost of crafting arrows, now it have become more affordable and are a good alternative in many aspects of the game.
- Reduced the requirement to craft a composite bow by 5 levels.
- Rebalanced hunting and composite bow, bow parameters are now in line with cost expectations.
- A leather sling has been added to the craft.
- Added new types of sling projectiles, including Spiked - with a chance to cause bleeding.

[b]Other changes and improvements:[/b]
- Improved the balance of the Echo Cave. Dangerous opponents have become weaker, and the rewards have been significantly increased.
- Improved the balance of godsends and rewards in the Fort.
- Crypts and the Necromancer's Laboratory are now considered as solo dungeons, you can only enter them alone.
- Now dangerous enemies and bosses have a corresponding postscript to understand their hardcore and the consequences of attacking them.
- Added Iron and Steel Anvils, which are required to craft high tier metal items.
- Improved action window interface, now actions are divided into categories.
- Added six dances.
- Added sound effects for Fort insects' actions and attacks
- Added Cultist sound effects.
- Long timers for production buildings have been reduced from 24 hours to 22 hours.
- Production building timers are now saved even if the server is restarted.
- Improved and optimized terrain surface graphics.
- Updated graphics for a pile of stones and branches, an iron vein.
- There are now fewer unlit areas in the Booming Echo Cave.

[b]Additional Pack Rewards:[/b] [i](to get it, you must re-enter your key in the main menu of the game)[/i]:
- It is now possible to enter the King's Tower and the Hero's Villa, as well as build constructions, furniture and decor inside. [i]The villa of a successful winemaker will be available later.[/i]
- Added wall decoration Shark.
- Added walls and towers of the King.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- Equipping rings from inventory by double clicking now works correctly.
- Fixed a bug due to which the player's grave did not appear if the number of dropped items exceeded the size of the grave container.
- Fixed a bug due to which the mobs in the dungeons did not restore health, being away from the players.
- Fixed bugs with recipes in the Fermentation Barrel.
- Fixed a bug due to which heavy shields could use effects from weapons or traps.
- Fixed a bug due to which it was possible to move the dominium so that parts of the buildings remained outside of it.
- Fixed a bug due to which mobs in the church could be killed with impunity from under the stairs.
- Fixed a bug due to which in some situations it was possible to remain on a mount when exiting a dungeon.
- Fixed a bug due to which death from bleeding caused by crafting was incorrectly credited to the last player who dealt damage to the deceased.
- Fixed a bug due to which the trading state of one of the players could persist, interfering with other actions, if another player disconnected from the server at the time of trading, died or was stunned
- Fixed a bug with sound settings in the game interface. The volume sliders now set the volume from 0 to 100%.

notes.title: Reports from the devfield. What we are working on?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/0a7eeb024427b7306cd688317d5d65b477e42de9.png[/img]

The next major update will be out on [b]April 22nd[/b]. We need more time to better tune and test new changes.

[u]What's will be included in this update:[/u]
[list]
[*] [b]Improving dungeon balance[/b]. For example, "Cave of the Booming Echo" will become easier, and the reward for it will be increased. The balance of other dungeons will also be improved.
[*] [b]Difficulty selection[/b]. Before entering the dungeon, you can choose one of five difficulties, from Easy to Nightmare (the current difficulty corresponds to Normal, the third in a row). The difficulty will determine the rewards, the levels of mobs, as well as their vulnerability to effects.
[*] [b]Solo Dungeons - Mines[/b]. Randomly generated dungeons for mining iron and other resources. There will also be non-difficult opponents and blockages that will need to be removed with a pickaxe and mining skill. You can only enter the Mines alone.
[*] [b]New mobs[/b]. Infected Bat, Cave Spider, and Treacherous Kobold.
[*] [b]Pack rewards[/b]. It will be possible to enter the Hero's villa and the King's tower, as well as install buildings and furniture inside. Added fortress walls and towers of the King, and a wall decoration Shark (Home, Sweet Home pack).
[*] [b]A tool for reporting offenders[/b]. If you meet an offender in the game world or in the chat, you can easily inform us about him by selecting the appropriate category: “Cheats / Using bugs”, “Bot program”, “Real money trading”, “Insults, excessive abuse”. This will help to better counteract violators and apply penalties.
[/list]

Also, the update will include several buildings and tools, dances, bug fixes, added sound effects and other changes.

notes.title: Hotfix 2.0.276
notes.content:
- Fixed several critical bugs and improved stability.

According to your reports, several players have been checked and banned. We remind you that trading for real money, abuse of vulnerabilities, swearing, and insults in the game chat is prohibited in the game. You can report violations to support@wildterra2.com, and in the next update, we plan to introduce a quick reporting system through the game.

notes.title: Reports from the devfield. What we are working on?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/96ddfe0a8d0d608487c3030e0280478bb9196faa.jpg[/img]

We plan to release the next major update on [b]April 15th[/b]. What we are working on right now and what will be included in this update?

[*] [b]Resource mines[/b]. Dungeons of a few rooms, where in addition to not challenging mobs, you will be able to mine iron and other resources. The entrance to such dungeons will be in one place all the time. [i]These are the dungeons we will add to the game earlier.[/i]
[*] [b]Dungeons to explore[/b]. Dungeons, the entrance to which will appear in a random place in the world of the game. Dungeons are sometimes large and sometimes small. With new opponents, bosses, diaries, stories, and random loot. These dungeons will be more varied - sometimes it will be a difficult challenge, and sometimes just a small basement with an interesting story. notes.title: Update 2.0.275. Windmill, alcohol and other changes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/82a00233046487ade73c192e716df067bbb0c5b1.jpg[/img]

This update adds a wooden windmill, the ability to brew alcoholic drinks, and many other improvements and fixes.

[b]New features and improvements:[/b]
- You can now craft alcohol. Brew different types of beer and other drinks!
- Added several stages of drunkenness with different effects and messages.
- Added "Vomit Potion" to Craft Healing, which removes medium and strong drunkenness.
- Added new buildings: Wooden mill, Fermentation barrel.
- Now the values of the regeneration of health and stamina per second are displayed on its indicators.
- In Restless Gorge, the number of iron deposits and the speed of its spawning have been slightly increased.
- Now, in addition to the Provocation ability, Heavy Shield Strike will also increase the desire to attack you. Ability descriptions now display the numerical value of threat points depending on the skill level.
- Tanks now do slightly less damage.
- Slightly weakened bronze armor and slightly improved iron and steel (iron set 120 is now slightly better than bronze 155).
- Added the ability to create Sugar from Sugar Syrup. And sugar syrup is now obtained by evaporating beets/honey in a cauldron.
- 1 sapling is now used for planting grapes, instead of 4 seeds.
- To grow peas, you now need to plant the peas themselves, not the seeds.
- Now when you click on a character portrait, the window for changing the portrait, title and frame will open.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed a bug due to which tanning vats could not be built on the floor.
- Fixed a bug due to which the Double XP chance of defense skills was not applied for heavy shields.
- Fixed a bug due to which various objects could visually remain and accumulate in the hands when changing equipment.
- Trees after harvesting will now display the harvest maturity timer.
- Fixed a bug due to which the container that opened when the secret bag was opened worked incorrectly.
- Fixed a bug due to which the secret bag was not opened by double-clicking and when using it from the hotbar.
- Fixed a bug due to which the pet could not change the target if the target is already selected.
- Fixed a bug due to which the use of instant abilities with effects moving to a target (for example, Sprint while running to a loot object) would interfere with the execution of an action.
- Fixed a bug due to which the music in the church could disappear when zooming and rotating the camera.
- Fixed a bug due to which window for changing and selecting a portrait, title, and frame were not closed by pressing the Esc key.
- Fixed graphics of some trees, improved graphics of the ground under garden trees.
- Improved the convenience of interacting with garden trees.
- Added graphics for bronze and iron shovel.
- Added warning and disconnection from the server for the duration of the database backup (once a day for several minutes).

notes.title: Hotfix 2.0.274
notes.content:
- Underground Guard and Stone Statues in the cave now do less damage to heavy armor.
- Reduced stun time from attacks by dwarves, Underground Guard and Stone Statues.
- Now negative effects on the player will persist after disconnecting from the server.
- Now, if a pet was attacked by a criminal or outlaw, then its automatic retaliatory attacks will not make its owner a criminal even after the attacker loses this status.
- Increased the minimum number of seeds when harvested to 5.
- Fixed a bug due to which when planting 4 seeds to get withered plants, you could get 3 withered plants.
- Fixed description of beets (about the method of obtaining seeds).
- Fixed translation of some crops and fruit trees in English.

notes.title: Hotfix 2.0.273
notes.content:
- The crime system now correctly accounts for pet attacks, as well as pet attacks on pets.
- Fixed a bug due to which the pet began to attack in response to the attack, even in passive modes.
- Fixed a bug due to which raw food could reduce the current satiety points.
- Improved characteristics of heavy shields.

notes.title: Major Update. Agriculture, Cooking, Combat System and countering criminals
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/3271cc21a181f9bd5b57bdbbfade11ae7e943906.png[/img]

Ten new crops for farming have been added to the game. Complex dishes will be in demand, and their bonuses have been increased. The first major stage of improving the combat system has been completed and a new skill has been added. Introduced system to counteract provocateurs and murderers of peaceful players, solved the problem with a shortage of free dungeons, added rewards from additional packs, and many other improvements!

Thanks a lot for your support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with each update!

[h3]Changelog. Major Update 2.0.272[/h3]

[b]Hidden bags and rewards of additional packs[/b]
To receive new rewards, you must reactivate your key in the game!
- Added rewards from additional packs. Prosperous merchant pack: Secret merchant bag, Elephant mount. King pack: Valorous Knight companion (pet).
- Added recipes for crafting secret bags in a game way.

[b]Countering killers of peaceful players[/b]
- Introduced a new system of penalties for attacking peaceful players. Provocateurs and murderers will receive temporary statuses "Criminal" and "Outlaw", thanks to which they risk losing items from their inventory and part of the money upon death, even while in a peaceful zone!

[b]Agriculture and Cooking[/b]
- Now you can grow: beets, cabbage, peas, onions, garlic, strawberries, grapes, apples, cherries, and pears. Some seeds can be obtained by breeding, and some can only be purchased from a merchant. Now there is no need to dig holes before sowing, and also, all actions are performed immediately with the bed, and not with single cells. *It will not work to plant new crops in old beds, you need to build new ones.
- Improved cooking system and food effect bonuses. Now you need to eat cooked food to restore your satiety score above 50%. Added new recipes, as well as a rolling pin and butcher hatchets. Also, food effects are now divided into several groups and only one effect from each group can be active on a player at a time.

[b]New skill and other changes to the combat system[/b]
- Shields are now divided into light and heavy (both the items themselves and the skills for their possession). Added new active and passive abilities to both skills. Blocking melee and ranged attacks are now separate stats.
- Reworked the aggression system for mobs. The "Provocation" active ability has been added to the Heavy Shields skill. Players can now provoke a target on themselves by acting as tanks. The effectiveness of the ability depends on the level of the Heavy Shields skill. Dealing high damage can also cause a mob to change its target.
- Added a new random unlockable bonus for pets "Provocation", which will significantly increase the level of aggression when triggered, which will make the pet a full-fledged tank.
- During the battle, you can no longer change armor and remove a heavy shield. The effect lasts 7 seconds after you attack or get hit.
- Now after disconnecting or exiting the game, the character remains in the game for another 10 seconds. Consider this and exit the game in a safe place.
- Parry can now only be triggered during your attack.
- The growth rate of skills Parry, Light and Heavy shields is increased.
- Rebalanced the characteristics of all armor and shields. Now it will be possible to reach the maximum values of the parameters of dodge and defense only with equipment of a high level and quality. Also, parts of one set of armor will give a different percentage of bonuses, depending on the amount of resources and skill required to create it. *For example, the chest armor will give more than the gloves.*

[b]Other changes and bug fixes:[/b]
- The number of simultaneously open dungeons has been significantly increased (you will no longer have problems entering and waiting).
- Fixed a bug due to which the Boar pet was not triggering the Fury ability.
- Fixed a bug due to which player's buildings could block the passages.
- Fixed a bug due to which some buildings could be built at the same point many times. All half-timbered roofs on the server have been removed to reduce the load.
- Some mobs and bosses will now be more difficult to defeat.
- Fixed a bug due to which volume control did not affect fireworks.
- Fixed a bug due to which bonuses could be triggered for broken weapons.
- Fixed a bug due to which the critical hit chance did not work when attacking with knives from the back.
- Fixed a bug due to which Parry could be triggered without weapons, with bows or throwing weapons.
- Fixed a bug due to which spears and sling projectiles could fly through the wall if you approach it at close range.
- Improved and optimized graphics of trees, wooden boxes, half-timbered roof.

notes.title: The release of the update has been postponed until tomorrow, March 19th
notes.content:
Friends!

We were incredibly eager to release the update today, but there are still a few critical bugs that we need to fix and test. We want to deliver better quality new content and need a little rest to complete the work.

The release of the update has been postponed until tomorrow, March 19. Hope for your understanding. Thanks for the support!

notes.title: Reports from the devfield. What we are working on?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/b8387009d894685da8e227544bfd9d2e71076e88.png[/img]

We plan to release the next major update on [b]March 18th[/b]. What we are working on right now and what will be included in this update?

Medium and high-level food will become more in demand and valuable, some of the recipes and effects will be reworked, new ones will appear, including “hidden” recipes (dishes that can only be cooked by experimenting). Butcher cleavers and wooden rolling pins will be added.

But some of the rewards that are difficult to produce (for example, Royal baths with servants) will appear in the game later.

notes.title: Update 2.0.271. Moderated chat and bug fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/73caeab38c2c21750b09d6f5bb1698cd9a48e2c9.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update 2.0.270. Map, pack rewards and many fixes

notes.title: Wild Terra 2 - Roadmap 2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/9418371de331e4dde06b91bf0905a2a9f1f8bef4.png[/img]

Thanks to everyone who supports Wild Terra 2, especially those who supported us from the earliest stages! It is thanks to you that we have come this long way. There are many more new features and improvements in the game ahead of us.

We are launching a public [url=https://discord.gg/MQNgKvhn5h]channel for your ideas and suggestions on our Discord[/url].
We remind you that we have [url=https://trello.com/b/clILRiKC/wild-terra-2-ideas]a public board with community ideas[/url], where, for example, you can see what has already been proposed or will be added in the near future.

Also, we make public [url=https://discord.gg/eSDTANT]the channel for voting[/url]. Right now, a vote on the priority of spring plans is taking place here, and your vote is important to us!

[h2]Roadmap 2021 [/h2]
[h3]Spring[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Improving Cooking[/b]. Long and effective buffs from high-level food. Limiting raw food and increasing the value of cooked food. Tools (pans, ladles, rolling pins). More secret recipes.
[*] [b]Improving Fishing[/b]. More interest and greater clarity. The division into different types of reservoirs with various inhabitants (including fishing in the dungeons). The size of the catch. More valuable catch.
[*] [b]Dungeon difficulty levels[/b]. Before entering the dungeon, you can choose the difficulty level. The harder it is, the more valuable the reward.
[*] [b]New content for farming[/b]. More crops and selection, the ability to grow trees, indoor plants. New tools and buildings.
[*] [b]Improving the combat system (in several stages)[/b]. New abilities. Increase the power of the Knives. Improved balance. Slow bolas and traps. Development of cooperative interaction in PvP and PvE. The role of a pronounced Tank and Support will appear. The tank will take more incoming damage in battle, quickly rush into the center of the fight, and attract monsters' attention to itself. Support will remove negative effects from allies, bandage wounds, and impose various weakening on opponents.
[*] [b]Upgrade exotic items[/b]. Several levels of upgrade, the further, the better the characteristics and unique properties. Adding a valuable resource to the game is universal for the latest upgrade levels of all exotic items.
[/list]
[h3]Summer[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Seaport town[/b]. A place for trade and sailing to other lands. New NPCs.
[*] [b]New continent.[/b] Territories with unexplored places, inhabitants, and resources. Spaces for settlements.
[*] [b]Auction[/b]. Convenient sale and purchase, search and sorting. 
[*] [b]Large individuals and large deposits[/b]. It will be possible to meet a larger representative of each type of animal and monster. He's more dangerous, but the reward is better. You'll also find large resources.
[*] [b]More passive bonuses for peaceful skills[/b]. Several passive bonuses for each peaceful skill.
[*] [b]Mini dungeons[/b]. Small dungeons with random generation for one player. The entrance will appear at a random location in the game world. 
[*] [b]Half-timbered parts[/b]. Parts for the construction of classic medieval houses. The new parts will be fully compatible with the logs.
[/list]
[h3]Autumn[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]First Season launch[/b]. More unexplored biomes. Territories with new rules, quests, and rewards.
[*] [b]New types of weapons and skills[/b]. Two-handed weapons, throwing bombs, crossbows, and more.
[*] [b]NPC quests and daily rewards[/b]. Daily quests with rewards. Mining resources and help NPCs.
[*] [b]More varied bosses[/b]. You will need unique tactics and quickly adapt to changing conditions.
[*] [b]Livestock[/b]. Breeding of farm animals. Cattle and small animals, birds, and insects.
[*] [b]Diseases and epidemics[/b]. Distributable diseases with negative effects. Treatment and consequences.
[*] [b]Alchemy[/b]. Craft unique ingredients for other production skills, as well as potions and decoctions.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2.0.269. Mute player and other chat options, new places to settle
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/ce4c1dc38ab1406ce3384ae8b8ba8e0110e2c91c.png[/img]

Added a button to ignore all messages from the player in the chat, the ability to copy the text of messages, invite the sender to a group or guild. Thanks to the sound notification, you will no longer miss a private message. And now there are more places to settle on Mainland!

[h3]Changelog. Update 2.0.269[/h3]

[b]New features and improvements[/b]
- Now, when you click on a message in the chat, you have the opportunity: mute player (ignore all messages from him), copy the text of the message, write a private message to the sender, invite to your group or guild.
- Added notification sound for private chat messages.
- On Mainland, some territories were freed up for settlements.
- Discord and Wiki buttons are now displayed in the game menu (by pressing Esc). 

[b]Fixes[/b]
- The walls of the cemetery are now blocking arrows and other projectiles.
- Fixed shooting through walls in the "Dwarven fortress" dungeon.
- Fixed a bug that sometimes could cause incomplete loading of items into containers when restarting the server.
- Fixed a bug due to which, when disconnecting from the server at the time of the completion of a trade operation, the money for the deal was sometimes not transferred.
- Fixed a bug due to which satiety was not reset if you die and disconnect from the server while in the dungeon.
- Fixed resource spawning in most inaccessible locations on Starting Island and Mainland.
- On Mainland, sharp corners of precipices near the water have been smoothed, now the transitions to water are smoother.

notes.title: Hotfix 2.0.268
notes.content:
With this update, server restart will be accompanied by special warnings 5 minutes before server restart. If you try to connect to the server at the time of its restart, the corresponding messages will be displayed.

[b]Fixes and improvements[/b]
- When dying in a dungeon, you will no longer be thrown out. Now, you appear at the beginning of the location. Resurrection waiting time in dungeons increased to 20 seconds. The waiting time for resurrection in other places has been increased to 10 seconds.
- Now, if a player loses the connection to the server inside the dungeon and logs into the game, he will appear before entering with the Appearance effect.
- When opening godsends or chests in dungeons, the disappearance timer does not work on them. You can no longer lose their content over time.
- Fixed a bug of trading between players, allowing you to change items in the trade window by moving items inside the inventory.
- Fixed a bug that occurred on the server when attacking a pet.
- Fixed a bug due to which the effects of the weapon in the right hand were applied when hitting with a shield.
- Now any charges and withdrawals of money are immediately synchronized with the database at the time of the transaction, which protects them from desynchronization when the server restarts.
- Fixed a rare bug due to which the amount of money in the inventory or prices on some resolutions were not visible or displayed incorrectly.
- Optimized methods related to throwing, dropping items on the ground, and picking them up.
- Fixed a bug due to which the Appearance effect did not subside if the character continued to move towards the selected target.
- Fixed display of the timer for effects and skill cooldowns, now the value 0 should not appear there if the time is less than a second.
- Fixed the error NetworkIdentity netId not found causing increased FPS.

notes.title: Update 2.0.267. Protecting peaceful players and freeing up space on Main Land
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/2cdad86bc5e5706b5b1e19adb8b74b2ac234fd8c.jpg[/img]

The timers for the long absence of players have been reduced so that space for new dominiums is quickly freed up. [i]We remind you that in case of a long absence you will not lose anything, your dominium with all the buildings and contents of the warehouses will be packed into your inventory.[/i]
Introduced measures to protect peaceful players from griefers, sprout timers are now saved, and servers are working even faster!

[h3]Changelog. Update 2.0.267[/h3]

[b]Fixes and improvements[/b]
- Now the absence time before auto-packing of the dominium on the continent is 3, 6 and 10 days (basic, medium, large, respectively). Timers have been reduced to prevent inactive players from taking up space on the Continent.
- Now, if you lose consciousness from the actions of another player in a peaceful zone, you will receive a temporary effect “Tranquility”, in which you do not take damage from other players until you start attacking them yourself or enter the danger zone.
- Now sprouts keep their timers even if the server is restarted.
- The watered Cereals stage is now more visible.
- Changed the hotkey for the action of demolishing a building in edit mode, and the action itself is now displayed in red to avoid accidental deletion by mistake.
- Increased the distance at which catching animals is triggered.
- Fixed a bug due to which it was possible to transfer Dominium stones and a log shed to the upper floors and foundations.
- Fixed a bug due to which it was possible to transfer a hut and a stone foundation to the upper floors and foundations.
- Fixed a bug due to which it was possible to appear at the place of death if disconnected from the server.
- Fixed a bug sometimes causing a red error in the console when selecting channels and pressing Enter.

[b]Server optimization[/b]
- Optimized places of saving, updating and deleting world objects and mobs in the database.
- Optimized write-off in the base: shells, bait, water, seeds, and durability, which could lead to slowdowns of the player's actions and increase the load on the server.
- Optimized saving to the database of mob deaths, generating loot for godsends, chests and mobs.

notes.title: Reports from the devfield. What we are working on?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/e275292f729973bff577c6ab3579234125368626.png[/img]

Hello friends!

Many thanks to everyone who plays Wild Terra 2 and supports us! 

We re-launched this section to tell you about what we are working on at the moment, news about our team, and plans.

Wild Terra 2 is created by a small team of very passionate people. Projects of this scale, as a rule, are developed by teams much larger than ours, and with only four people in the team - develop Wild Terra 2 to Early Access was really difficult! Now the team will grow to develop the game even faster!

In addition to solving technical problems, we are working on adding the Map, chat moderation tools, all rewards from additional packs, and new music. We are also making further plans to present you with an updated roadmap.

Last time, we did not manage to complete all the points from the declared roadmap. Game development is a complex process. Sometimes, along the way, you have to spend a lot of time improving what has already been created or encounter difficulties, the solution of which will take much longer than the expected time. We will try to treat the compilation of the new roadmap as responsibly as possible and take into account many nuances that we will have to face.

[u]Map[/u]
We will add the Map to the game soon. It will be divided into global (showing all islands and continents) and local (map of a specific continent). notes.title: Early Access FAQ
notes.content:
[h3]Why Early Access?[/h3]
We are a small team of people fond of the era of early online sandboxing and the isometric classic of games full of freedom and opportunity. Wild Terra 2 is the ideological successor of the sandboxes of those times, embodied using modern developments of the genre and technologies and successful solutions from Wild Terra Online.

In our game, you, together with other players, create your own medieval world: from the first tools to a full-fledged life, economy, and guilds. In a game with such mechanics, you are given a key role, and for the full development of the project, we need a dialogue with you. By providing early access, we hope to receive feedback and suggestions to adjust the development of the game early on. We consider all ideas and select from them the most suitable and liked ones.

We run a [url=https://trello.com/b/clILRiKC/wild-terra-2-ideas]public board with community ideas[/url], where you can see what has already been added to the game or is expecting you soon.

[h3]Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?[/h3]
The full version is scheduled for release in late 2021. There is an active development of the game, a continuous process of adding new features and adjusting what has already been done.
As soon as we understand that everything we wanted has already been implemented, refined, and perfected, Wild Terra 2 will be out of Early Access. But the development will not end there either. After the release, we will continue to improve and fill our game.

[h3]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?[/h3]
While Wild Terra 2 will be in Early Access, we will be expanding the possibilities of the game with every update. It isn't easy to list everything that we have planned for the release, but the most important thing is worth noting:
- A new continent every season! With its own biomes, rules, inhabitants, dungeons, resources and rewards.
- Improvement and content for Farming. Many new cultures, weather and seasons influences.
- Livestock breeding and selection.
- Even more elements for building houses, creating furniture and decor.
- Special activities for solo players.
- Skills Cartography, Witchcraft, Bard.
- Improved combat system with even more variety of equipment, skills and roles.
- New types of weapons and skills for using them: Crossbows, Two-handed, Polearms, Weapons in both hands, Throwing bombs, Staffs and Musical instruments.
- Castle sieges and PvP tournaments.
- Development of guilds. Special dungeons with activities, bosses and rewards. Guild Wars.

In addition to everything planned, the game will be expanded with a considerable number of aspects proposed by the community - this is the goal of Early Access!

[h3]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/h3]
Many of our plans and player suggestions have already been implemented in Wild Terra 2. Together with you, we will refine the game, make it better and more diverse with each update. Despite the team's small size, we plan to delight you with new updates 2-3 times a month. The game is continuously being filled with something new, improve, and the found shortcomings are eliminated.

A large number of essential features have already been added to Wild Terra 2, which will only increase over time:
[list]
[*] Survival in a huge world.
[*] Hunting, resource mining and finding godsends.
[*] Crafts: Blacksmithing, Mining, Leatherworking and Pottery, Carpentry, Farming, Cooking and many others.
[*] Lots of realistic production processes.
[*] Trade with other players and non-player characters.
[*] Taming animals and pumping pets.
[*] Free construction of multi-level buildings.
[*] Improvement of home and personal property.
[*] Completing various quests.
[*] Dungeon exploration.
[*] Boss battles for valuable rewards.
[/list]

[h3]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?[/h3]
Yes, the price of the game on Early Access will be lower than the price of the final release version.

[h3]How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?[/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/NZhbfMR]Our Discord channel[/url] contains the largest part of the active community of the game.

Any of the players can suggest adding something new or, on the contrary, removing and reworking the existing one. You can discuss your ideas with other players on Discord and us. Also, the community actively contributes to finding and fixing bugs in the game.
Public board with a list of found and fixed bugs: https://trello.com/b/17NM90SF/wild-terra-2-bugtracker

The community of players fills the wiki with knowledge about Wild Terra 2, helping newcomers navigate the game more quickly, organizing all the information available, and making it easier to work with it.

[url=https://wikien.wildterra2.com/]Wild Terra 2 official wiki[/url]

We plan to reward all those actively involved in developing the project with in-game bonuses and access keys for their friends. Join us now and help make Wild Terra 2 even better!

[h3]Changelog. Update 2.0.260[/h3]

Added Italian and Japanese languages. Thanks to everyone who helps translate the game!

[b]Completely redesigned Chat[/b] 
- Chat channels are now tabbed. You can choose to display all messages at once, or messages from a specific channel, for example, "Trade".

[b]Feudal lords and Peons[/b]

Peon:

- Starts on a continent with no money or resources (skips starting quests).

[b]Other changes and improvements[/b]
- Added a helmet for the Builder pack. To receive it - enter your Builder rewards key.
- Now, as a reward for completing many quests, money is given, so after sailing from the Starting Island, a good initial capital is already being collected.

notes.title: Wild Terra 2 - Steam Early Access launch. Memo about wipe and access packs
notes.content:
[h2]When is the game will launch on Steam Early Access?[/h2]
January 28th. The exact launch time, as well as the wipe, will be announced later.

[h2]Will there be a wipe?[/h2]
January 26th, we will hold a wipe procedure (removal of all current progress). We have no plans to make wipes after the game goes into Early Access.

[h2]When can I start playing?[/h2]
All Settlers, Conquerors, Heroes, their invited friends, and special packs owners can play now. However, keep in mind that your progress will be completely reset during the wipe!

Owners of ALL access packs (as well as invited friends) will be able to start playing on January 26th (48 hours before the game goes into Early Access) with all progress saved.
It will be possible to purchase the game on Steam and start playing on this version from January 28th.

[h2]How much will the game cost on Steam?[/h2]
The cost of the game will be about 15% higher than the price of the Builder pack. Buying an access pack now is a great way to save money, earn extra rewards, and start playing earlier.

[h2]Will the current access packs or their rewards be available for purchase after January 28th?[/h2]
No, the current access packs were created to provide unique rewards to all those who support the project in the earliest stages. On January 28th, these packs will no longer be available for purchase, and their rewards will become genuinely exclusive and rare!

[h2]How do I get rewards of my pack after the wipe?[/h2]
You will need to re-enter your in-game reward key.
If you have lost this key (in an email from Xsolla after payment), contact the technical support of the payment system for its recovery: [url=https://help.xsolla.com/]https://help.xsolla.com/[/url]

[h2]Will there be a problem with a lack of territories or resources at the start?[/h2]
- Firstly, we will introduce restrictions against the seizure of territory by twinks (one dominium per account) and also add a way to skip the starting island with some limits (inability to have your dominium, but only to be a resident of other players),
- secondly, during the free periods (about 13,000 people played during the Free Week), we have already fixed several problems with the lack of spawn and territories, 
Thirdly, because many will start playing two days earlier, they will be able to move to the mainland even before the start of Early Access. 
If the number of players far exceeds our expectations, then the solution to the problem will be the opening of new servers.

[h2]Why does Wild Terra 2 need Early Access? How long will the game be in Early Access?[/h2]
Answers to these and other questions can be found on our page on Steam: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1134700]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1134700[/url]

notes.title: Major Update 2.0.255. Winter, new dungeon and town halls!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/dbf354650b5baeee6343ec21bb105842f6fce4fa.png[/img]

A new dungeon is already available! Now Dominiums occupy only 1 square, added Town Halls, villas and statues. Snow has fallen in the world of Wild Terra 2, many bugs have been fixed and some improvements have been added.

[u][b]You have not lost items from the dominium warehouse, they are now in the storehouse of the Town Hall.[/b][/u]

[h3][url=https://www.wildterra2.com/]Purchase a pack and start playing on closed testing[/url][/h3]

[h3]Town Halls and Dominiums[/h3]
- Now dominiums occupy only 1 square in the center of the territory and are used to manage the territory. You have not lost items from the dominium warehouse, they are now in the storehouse of the Town Hall.
- Added a new type of building the Town Hall. This building is used for access to the personal warehouse as well as the management of residents. The better the Town Hall, the more people can live on your territory, and more storage cells are available.

[h3]Rewards[/h3]
To unlock new recipes, you must re-enter the reward key some time after the update.
- Added recipes for villas (town halls) for owners of the Hero and the Prosperous Merchant packs, as well as the Great Tower for Kings. The inner part of the Town Hall and the wine cellar will be added later.
- Added recipes for dragon statues for Heroes and Kings.

[h3]New dungeon[/h3]
- Added a large dungeon with monsters, bosses, new rewards and mechanics. Please note that this dungeon is for high level players.
Many thanks to everyone who helped test the new dungeon!

[h3]General improvements[/h3]
- Improved optimization when snow falls. The initial season on the server will be winter for some time.
- Added sound effects for the Master of the Mountains.
- Improved initial quests, taking into account the separation of the Town Hall and Dominium.
- More branches now fall from trees on the starting island and birches.
- Simplified fox taming so that the initial quest to tame it on the island does not take so long.
- Now the success rate for loot and recipes is displayed even if the tool is not yet equipped. The best tool in the inventory is taken into account, which will be used when automatically equipping.
- Slightly increased the distance at which objects of the world appear when the character moves, to avoid situations where they appear suddenly.
Fixes
- Fixed a bug due to which the cloak fell inside the collider and stopped the cloth simulation. Sometimes it can still happen again.
- Fixed a bug due to which the pet could be resummoned in battle immediately after dealing damage, due to which the pet did not take damage. This is no longer possible until the pet is out of combat.
- Fixed a bug with auto-equipment broken tools.
- Fixed a bug due to which, due to passive skills, it was possible to collect materials even with a too strong difference in skills, and also spoil resources if the skill is not enough to collect. This will not be possible now.
- Fixed a bug due to which the grains stopped replenishing satiety.
- Fixed a critical bug due to which some of the buildings could cause a violation of the packing procedure for dominiums.
- Fixed an issue where disconnecting from the server caused issues that required restarting the game.
- Fixed a bug due to which purchased items were of zero durability.
- Fixed a bug due to which, due to passive skills, it was possible to obtain high-level craft experience when unsuccessful attempts to make too complex recipes. This will not be possible now.
- Fixed a bug due to which mobs could stop responding to the damage inflicted on the border of the player's pursuit zone.
- Fixed a bug due to which health bars and effect icons were mistakenly considered active interface elements, due to which attacks were not performed if the cursor was over them.
- Fixed a bug due to which the actions started immediately after releasing the movement key were interrupted.
- Fixed a bug due to which the quality of books could sometimes not be displayed in the tooltip.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/4914a17477b9fc8970a7656a557311bf9d9ec081.jpg[/img]

We launched a test server to debug major changes, added the ability to assign residents, Hero rewards, new sounds and music, and many other improvements and fixes. The game is now also available in Polish and French.

[h3][url=https://www.wildterra2.com/]Purchase a pack and start playing in closed testing[/url][/h3]

More details about test server: https://discord.gg/PF7Uc5xVr9
New high-level dungeon already available on the test server.

[h3]Changelog. Major Update 2.0.251[/h3]
The game is now available in Polish and French! Many thanks to everyone who contributed to the translation of the game.

[b]What's new:[/b]
- Added the ability to designate players as "residents" on your territory. A player can be a resident of only one dominium (his own, or another player). If you are a resident outside of your territory, you will also have access to a personal warehouse in the dominium, and a pointer to the house will be displayed.
[i]We want to make it possible to live comfortably with a friend on the same territory. Later, a restriction on the number of residents will be added, it will be possible to use the help of a friend during construction and crafting. We will closely monitor post-implementation feedback to ensure that balances and limits are properly adjusted. [/i]
- Hero owners can now build unique towers and statues. Some time after the update, you will need to re-enter the reward key to unlock new recipes.
- Now, when leaving the dungeon, the player is invulnerable for 15 seconds, or until he starts to move or do something.
- Disabled flowers and other small decorative bushes. [i]We'll add them later in the form of harvested herbs used in crafting items, consumables, and food.[/i]
- Slightly improved the visibility of harvested herbs and berries.
- Now, if the food has effects, then it can be eaten even if the satiety is full.
- Now slows from equipment (for example, from a backpack) do not apply when using mounts.
- Now, when interacting with an NPC, the character is automatically dismounted.
- Skeletons are now immune to bleeding and poisoning.
- Added the ability to sort items in closets.
- Added the ability to build stone walls 1 cell wide.
- Added city and bridges to the minimap.

[b]Balance[/b]
- Significantly increased the upper tensile durability for most weapons, tools, shields, and armor made of bronze.
- Now the durability of the weapon from triggered parries is reduced by only 1 point, and the durability of armor and shield is reduced by 25% instead of 33% of the absorbed or blocked damage.
- Reduced skill requirements for crafting bronze and leather armor.
- It will now be possible to create improved versions of reward helmets and rings so that they lag less behind their counterparts created in the game.
- Now, if an ability is interrupted before using it with a stun, then you have to wait for the cooldown of this ability. - Affects both animals and monsters, as well as players and their pets.
- Significantly increased the throw time for all mountain warriors.
- Fixed a bug due to which the damage from some abilities was calculated incorrectly, ignoring protective effects and bonuses.
- The movement speed reduction when equipping backpacks is now 20% instead of 30%.

[b]Quests[/b]
- Now the quest to build a structure will be considered completed if you have already built such a building in your dominium zone. Unpacking buildings also counts towards quests.
- Increased the chance of a root crop spawning on the starting island, now it also spawns in an abandoned village.
- Fixed a bug due to which the identification of several items in the same stack was not taken into account in the quest and the amount of experience gained.
- Fixed a bug due to which items received as a reward for quests were given with zero durability.

[b]Sounds and Music:[/b]
- Added skeletons sound fx.
- Added dwarfs sound fx.
- Added music in the Church.
- Added music in the Cave.
- Improved the sounds of taking damage to the character.
- Decreased the volume for the sound effects of failure and chopping down a tree.

[b]Other fixes:[/b]
- Fixed jerks in the movement of animals and monsters.
- Fixed a bug due to which rewards could be transferred through the trade window.
- Fixed a bug due to which the character turned downside if the abilities on the panel are clicked with the mouse.
- Fixed a bug due to which reward helmets were issued with zero durability.
- Fixed a bug due to which officers could not demote and increase the rank of other guild members.
- Fixed a bug due to which the character could remain on the mount when unpacking buildings from the dominium.
- Fixed errors that occurred when creating a new character, if the name is already taken. Character creation error messages are now localized.
- Fixed a bug due to which, after creating 5 characters, a situation could arise when the server began to disconnect when trying to connect to it.
- Fixed a bug due to which campfires and beds could be moved or unpacked outside the dominium so that their owner did not reset and the disappearance timer did not appear.
- Fixed a bug due to which the check for satiety on food only occurred after the timer expired.
- Fixed a bug due to which when repairing one item from the vendor, it did not disappear in the repair list.
- Fixed a localization error made by translators, due to which an error with quests appeared in the German version of the game.
- Improved visual display of iron ore.
- Reduced the darkening effect around the corners.
- Small animals no longer move the character.

notes.title: Wild Terra 2 Early Access release on Steam Postponed to 28th January 2021

Thanks to everyone who supports us! Thanks to you, a lot has already been added and corrected. We want to maximize the quality of the game before the Early Access release, and this will require a number of changes and bug fixes. Also, we will add a lot of new content!

The updated roadmap can be viewed on our [url=https://trello.com/b/clILRiKC/wild-terra-2-ideas]public suggestions board.[/url]

Yes, the price of the game in all currencies will be about 15% more expensive than the Builder pack.

Settler, Conqueror or Hero. 

[h3]Will these packs be available after launch? Can the pack be upgraded?[/h3]
These packs and their rewards may only be purchased before Early Access launches. If you would like to upgrade your pack to a higher one, please [url=https://discord.gg/NZhbfMR]write to us on Discord[/url].

notes.title: Hotfix 2.0.248
notes.content:
- The cost of repairs for money is reduced by 3 times.
- The amount of materials required for repairs has been reduced by 2 times.
- The maximum Durability limit for all exotic equipment and weapons is increased by 50%.
- The cost of the durability of shields and armor when blocking damage is reduced by 3 times.

- Tool will now lose durability when mining, crafting, repairing and building depending on the difference in skills. If the target's level is less than or equal to the skill level, then only a unit of durability will be lost, if the level is higher, but no more than 10 levels, then 2, if more - then 3. If your try fails, 4 points of durability will are lost.

- Fixed a bug due to which repairs did not work (for materials).
- Fixed a bug due to which there was no resource spawn in the final part of the Cave.
- Fixed a bug due to which in some situations it was still possible to replace the used item at the start of its timer.
- Fixed a loot bonus bug for baked trout.
- Fixed a bug with incorrect display of silver coins.
- Changed the font and colors of messages in the chat.
- Improved readability of world object timers.
- Changed the font in notes and books.
- Changed the font in the pointers.
- Fixed a bug due to which the quality boundaries were not displayed when crafting.

notes.title: Major Update 2.0.247
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/5266e7ae0d00fe31d4d7efb9d82c0fea4892c503.jpg[/img]

This update adds Durability and repair of equipment, new tools, bandages and ointments, changed dungeon rewards, updated fonts, and over 30 other important improvements and fixes!

[h2]Changelog. Update 2.0.247[/h2]

[h3]What's new:[/h3]
- Tools, weapons, and other equipment now have Durability, which is consumed when using an item, as well as when a character dies. When the durability indicator reaches a critical level, the item can only be used after repair. You can repair items from merchants (for money), or yourself (for resources). Added various indicators and icons for durability and repair.

- Added Copper and Bronze Buckets, Bronze, and Iron Shovels to Crafting recipes.
- Bandages that remove the effects of Burning, as well as a healing ointment, have been added to the Healing recipes.
- Replaced fonts.

[h3]Improvements and fixes:[/h3]
- Reworked the system for spawning enemies and resources in dungeons. Now in the Cave of Booming Echoes, they will be different each time.
- Objects will now spawn in the Necromancer Lab dungeon.
- Fixed loot from dwarves, as well as in the church, cave, and mausoleums in the cemetery.
- Fixed a bug due to which almost no money appeared anywhere in the loot.
- Fixed bug with an increased amount of gems in rocks.
- Now, if there is not enough space during mining, then all the free space is filled first, but only that which does not fit will fall to the ground.
- Now for rare resources and external bosses, the respawn time is not strictly fixed, so that they cannot be controlled by the same group, each time returning at the right time.
- Reduced the number of wolves and mountain guards spawning in the gorge.
- Reworked the restoration of the health of animals and monsters. Now they do not recover for some time after receiving and dealing hits.

- Arrows and spears using metal are now produced in 2 times more than before.
- Increased the amount of metal in most blacksmith recipes.
- Increased the number of consumable ingredients for recipes purchased from vendors and reduced their price to make items easier to repair.
- Changed the number of ingredients for exotic recipes to make them rarer but also more valuable.
- Merchants now pay more for culinary products.

- Fixed a bug due to which the timer for updating dungeons did not increase.
- Fixed a bug due to which in dungeons after re-entering the game there was incorrect lighting.
- Fixed a bug due to which the arrow of the statue with the bow hit the sarcophagus when firing.
- Fixed a bug due to which in the stunning state it was possible to change equipment, items in the inventory, and containers.
- Fixed a bug that allowed to drag (including by sorting items) a used item at the time of the use timer, which could lead to the removal of other items from the inventory.
- Fixed a bug due to which the unpacked crops did not work after relocating.
- Drying time for all crops increased to 24 hours.
- Fixed a bug due to which buildings could be moved or unpacked to someone else's dominium, where access was open, which caused them to work incorrectly.
- Fixed a bug due to which in production buildings materials continued to be spent if there was no space left for the result of the process.
- Fixed a bug due to which the process of drying or tanning hides did not start over after restarting the server or unpacking a building after relocating.
- Now the timer for drying and tanning processes does not start over if you move, pick up results or add materials.
- Fixed a bug due to which the bows and outfit of the nobleman could not be put on if there was not enough empty space in the inventory, even if there was nothing to remove.
- Fixed a bug due to which, when controlled by the keyboard, the character could start running to the last memorized point indicated by the mouse when using attacks or skills.
- Fixed a bug due to which the full metal helmet did not block the view when equipped, as planned.
- Fixed a bug due to which the lion (hero's pet), the chance of a stunning effect was higher than that of regular pets.
- Fixed bugs due to which buckets were not displayed in the character window.
- Fixed a bug due to which the increased size of the interface was not saved after restarting the game.
- The number of items in the stacks is now displayed on the right side.
- Fixed a bug in messages about accepting victims for the executioner's grave.
- Possibly fixed a bug causing the game to crash in minimized mode, need to check it.
- Minor improvements in server optimization.

notes.title: Answers to frequently asked questions about wipes, testing, packs and rewards
notes.content:
[h3]How to start playing now?[/h3]
The game is still under development, but you can start playing now. You need the Settler, Conqueror or Hero Access Pack, which can be purchased at [url=https://www.wildterra2.com/]https://www.wildterra2.com/[/url]. Please note that the Builder gives access when the game will be released.

[h3]When will there be wipes (deleting all progress) and what is it for?[/h3]
[b]The wipe will happen 2 days before the Early Access release[/b]. This wipe is necessary for the final balance setting after fixing major holes and flaws. After this wipe (48 hours before the release of the game), owners of ALL access packs will be able to start playing and developing earlier than others.

[h3]Will there be discounts on access packs? Will the packs be on sale after the game is released?[/h3]
No, there will be no discounts on access packs. Moreover, the packs are available now - they will no longer be available for purchase after the game is released. You can only get unique rewards by purchasing a pack right now.

[h3]Will the price of the game increase after the Early Access release?[/h3] 
Yes, the game will cost $34.99 (29.99 eur) without additional rewards. You can save money by purchasing the Builder pack now for $29.99 (22.99 eur), and also get additional rewards (unique helmet, title, access 2 days earlier than others). Prices in other currencies will also increase by about 15%.

[h3]When will the game be released on Steam Early Access?[/h3]
The game will be released on Steam Early Access in December 2020.

[h3]Can rewards from packs be lost or transferred? Will I be able to purchase these rewards separately later?[/h3]
All rewards cannot be lost or transferred in any way. Also, all rewards in packs are unique and can only be obtained from these packs, and in no other way.

[h3]Can I get rewards from multiple packs?[/h3]
Yes, you can purchase multiple packs and receive all the rewards on one account.

[h3]What gives access to elite channels on Discord?[/h3]
The Settler, Conqueror and Hero Packs also have access to Elite Channels. Your ideas and suggestions will be noticed, you will be able to vote and discuss the creation of a game with the developers. After the release of the game in Early Access, you will also have premium access to these channels, you will be able to further influence the development of the game, as well as receive exclusive news before others.

[h2][url=https://www.wildterra2.com/]Purchase an access pack and start playing[/url][/h2]

notes.title: Answers to frequently asked questions about wipes, testing, packs and rewards
notes.content:
[h3]How to start playing now?[/h3]
The game is still under development, but you can start playing now. You need the Settler, Conqueror or Hero Access Pack, which can be purchased at [url=https://www.wildterra2.com/]https://www.wildterra2.com/[/url]. Please note that the Builder gives access when the game will be released.

[h3]The game is always available, or will there be breaks in testing?[/h3]
Early testing took place in stages, between which there were breaks. However, now and before Early Access release, you can play continuously! Buy a pack and play whenever you want.

[h3]When will there be wipes (deleting all progress) and what is it for?[/h3]
[b]The nearest wipe will take place on September 30[/b]. Now the game has faster leveling and extraction of resources, there is no currency, and items have no durability. From October 1, the stage begins, at which we will set the rates of gathering and leveling close to those that we plan to introduce after the release of the game. This wipe is needed to test the balance of leveling, mining and the economy of the game. The balance will still be far from ideal, but we will correct it thanks to your feedback.

[b]The second (last) wipe will happen 2 days before the Early Access release[/b]. This wipe is necessary for the final balance setting after fixing major holes and flaws. After this wipe (48 hours before the release of the game), owners of ALL access packs will be able to start playing and developing earlier than others.

[h3]Will there be discounts on access packs? Will the packs be on sale after the game is released?[/h3]
No, there will be no discounts on access packs. Moreover, the packs are available now - they will no longer be available for purchase after the game is released. You can only get unique rewards by purchasing a pack right now.

[h3]Will the price of the game increase after the Early Access release?[/h3] 
Yes, the game will cost $34.99 (29.99 eur) without additional rewards. You can save money by purchasing the Builder pack now for $29.99 (22.99 eur), and also get additional rewards (unique helmet, title, access 2 days earlier than others). Prices in other currencies will also increase by about 15%.

[h3]When will the game be released on Steam Early Access?[/h3]
The game will be released on Steam Early Access in December 2020.

[h3]Can rewards from packs be lost or transferred? Will I be able to purchase these rewards separately later?[/h3]
All rewards cannot be lost or transferred in any way. Also, all rewards in packs are unique and can only be obtained from these packs, and in no other way.

[h3]Can I get rewards from multiple packs?[/h3]
Yes, you can purchase multiple packs and receive all the rewards on one account.

[h3]What gives access to elite channels on Discord?[/h3]
The Settler, Conqueror and Hero Packs also have access to Elite Channels. Your ideas and suggestions will be noticed, you will be able to vote and discuss the creation of a game with the developers. After the release of the game in Early Access, you will also have premium access to these channels, you will be able to further influence the development of the game, as well as receive exclusive news before others.

[h2][url=https://www.wildterra2.com/]Purchase an access pack and start playing[/url][/h2]

notes.title: More about the city, new locations, agriculture, bags. What we are working on
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/b4ae49f146484ec7e1f50ee8639958e0a97bc9b0.jpg[/img]

[h3]Bags[/h3]
Developed and added bags that increase the number of slots in the inventory (depending on quality), but give a small penalty to movement speed. Bags are equipped in a slot and are displayed on the character's back, and only one bag can be equipped at a time. In addition to the usual bags, one exotic will be added, to which a lamp will be attached. The bags will appear in the game in the next update!

[h3]Central City[/h3]
Part of the territories and basic models of buildings and decorations were made. In the city, you will meet merchants and artisans from whom you can get various quests, sell special items, as well as purchase recipes and some consumables. Later, a bank with a warehouse will be added, and it will also be possible to purchase a home for furnishing, as well as fast travel.

We planned to release an update with the central city this summer, but due to the large volume of accompanying mechanics (NPC, currency, trade, quests, methods of obtaining currency, recipes unlocked for currency, etc.), the launch of the city is postponed to autumn.

[h3]Snow mountain territory and a new dungeon[/h3]
The story and monsters for the new location have been worked out. It will be a snow-covered mountainous area where guards live, holding back the onslaught of monsters from the dungeon. New quests, a new type of metal, new equipment, new monsters, and bosses are waiting for you!

[h3]Agriculture[/h3]
In the near future, will also take on Agriculture, and plan to launch it this month. A system of growing crops in several stages, plant breeding, use of fertilizers, tools, fight against pests, diseases, weeds, and soil depletion awaits you. The weather and seasons will also affect the harvest. Initially, only basic features will be available, and all of the above will be introduced into the game gradually.

notes.title: Major Update 2.0.231. Cooking, pottery, and improvements of the combat system
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36220547/4731aff3b383f2be6e223895be1c38f3bf02eefb.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/4731aff3b383f2be6e223895be1c38f3bf02eefb.jpg[/img][/url]

[u]Cooking and pottery:[/u]
- Added buildings for cooking: Campfire with a cauldron, Cook's workplace, Stone and Brick ovens, Juice press.
- Added over 30 recipes and ingredients for Cooking.
- Added 5 drink recipes.
- Added various food and drink effects.
- Added buildings Potter's wheel and Pottery kiln.
- Added recipes for clay things: bowl, pot, jug, and bricks.

[u]Combat system and weapons:[/u]
- Health indicators are now automatically displayed above wounded enemies.
- Added display of positive and negative effects applying to the enemy.
- The names of special attacks are displayed before the attack starts, to make the fight more interesting and manageable. Now you can react in a timely manner and take countermeasures.

*Some skills and perks will be able to partially or completely ignore absorption and defense.*
- Blunt weapons now have partial ignore absorption and defense.
- The ability "Hold the line" now increases the absorption of 2 times instead of absorbing all damage at all, but the duration has been increased.
- Abilities "Backstab" and "Shattered" now completely ignore absorption.
- Added ignore absorption and defense for some monsters and bosses.

- Reflected damage changed and weakened. The defense stat now correctly reduces reflected damage.
- The parry skill has been reworked to only work with a suitable weapon and the parry chance depends on the type of weapon.

- Now the flight speed of ranged ammo is different and depends on its type.
- Added recipes for arrowheads.
- Added iron and steel arrows.
- Added recipes for two new bows: Hunter bow and Composite bow.
- Bow stats have been rebalanced.
- Added 2 abilities for the skill Bows - slow, but strong shots, causing critical damage or injury.
- Added ability for the Throwing weapons skill - a throw that stuns a target.
- The passive ability "Weak Point" is now an ability of the Throwing weapon skill, not Bows.
- For bows, the passive ability “Bleeding Wound” has been added, causing bleeding.

Various protective effects have been added to the most powerful monsters:
- Resistant to any kind of injury, stun, slowdown, or all negative effects in general.
- Added partial reflection of incoming damage to the swamp boss "Devourer".

[u]What's new:[/u]
- In the game world, you can now find and collect berries: Blueberries, Lingonberries, and Wild Strawberries.
- Hazel and Wild Greens are also available for gather.
- Added Hives, from which you can get honey, as well as Nests of wild birds, for obtaining eggs and feathers.
- Increased player absence time before automatic packing of dominium.
- Added timers for using items, summoning pets and mounts.
- For pets, damage per second is now also displayed, which takes into account all bonuses received by the pet.

[u]Fixes and improvements:[/u]
- Made improvements to eliminate sudden impassable walls and improve movement within multi-story buildings. Need test.
- Fixed a bug due to which the effect of Rage on animals, monsters, and pets did not work as intended. It removes the delay between attacks, thereby significantly increasing the damage done per unit of time.
- Fixed a bug due to which during an attack, mining, or other actions, it was possible to change equipment.
- Fixed a bug due to which the doorway was not packed when moving the dominium to another location.
- Fixed a bug due to which some shields could not be displayed in the equipment window.
- Fixed a bug due to which arrows of stone statue flew over pets without causing them damage.
- Fixed timers for some abilities of monsters and bosses.
- Death from reflected damage is now taken into account in quests.
- Fixed a bug due to which stunning a skeleton with a shield could not be counted in the quest.
- Reduced damage dealt without weapons.
- Updated the appearance of the stone dominium and stone walls.
- In the crafting and building menu, all sections are collapsed by default.

notes.title: Pets in Wild Terra 2. Catching, taming, leveling and breeding
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/72fdb48df0b3b2b07b7da6415ea9f9d80f3fd32f.png[/img]

In this article we will tell you more about the taming and leveling of pets, bonuses, as well as whether it is planned in a finished form.

[h3]Catching and taming[/h3]
To catch your future pet, you need to throw a created snare to an animal and slow it down (large individuals will need to be pre-loosened). The caught animal has the “Fear Level” parameter, and in order for the future pet to recognize you as its master, it is necessary to care for it and periodically feed it. For the successful catching and taming, the level of skill “Taming” is also important.

[h3]Leveling and bonuses[/h3]
Has your pet already recognized you as its owner? Great, it's time to start training him. Take it with you and while you are fighting, it is level-up along with you. Pets will have a number of their own features, characteristics and abilities, as well as some bonuses for the owner - all this will be unlocked with an increase the level of the pet. Some of the bonuses will be random, and it is possible to get extremely rare sets of features (and when breeding a new individual, features inherent in its nature will also depend on its parents, and the influence of chance will be less. [i]See Breeding and exchange[/i]).

[u]Examples of random bonuses for a fighting pet[/u]: special attacks and debuffs, a chance to inflict bleeding, increased damage, increased armor, small animals stop running away, wild animals do not attack, etc.
[u]Examples of random bonuses for a peaceful pet[/u]: a bonus to the growth of a specific peaceful skill of the owner, bonuses for gathering, etc.
[u]Examples of features known in advance (not random)[/u]: devotion (the inability to lose a pet at death), a bag for items, the ability to be a mount.

[h3]Breeding and exchange[/h3]
Among other parameters, all pets will also be divided by gender. Put two pets with different sexes of the same species in the pen, and after a while you can get a new one. The characteristics of the resulting pet will pretty much depend on the characteristics of its parents, but some of the abilities will still remain random.

For example, if you want to get a fairly strong “tank”, you should first create M and F pets, each of which will be have dominated protective features (bonuses to maximum health, protection, etc.). In this case, their pet is likely to have the best protective set of features.
Pets can also be exchanged with other players and sold at auction.

notes.title: Wild Terra 2. Reports from the devfield. Abilities and bonuses from skills
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/91f51dba7e32fbb2462ce971d2ec98cdf5ebc579.jpg[/img]

Implemented a system of passive abilities and bonuses that are unlocked at different skill levels. New abilities are displayed in the Book of Skills, message output is added when a level is received.

[h3]New bonuses and abilities:[/h3]
[b]Heavy armor.[/b] Main bonus: damage absorption.
Active ability "Tenacity". Reduces damage taken by half. Turns off running and slows down your movement.
Passive ability “Spikes”. Reflects some of the absorbed melee damage back to the attacker.
Passive ability “Blades”. Reflects even more absorbed melee damage back to the attacker.
[b]Light armor.[/b] Main bonus: evasion.
Passive ability “Dodge pace”. Briefly speeds up the movement after each successful dodge.
[b]Shields.[/b] Main bonus: block.
Active ability “Rise the shield”.Blocks all damage is taken if it does not ignore protection. Turns off running and slows down your movement.
Passive ability “Firm hand”. The shield continues to block even in stun.
Passive ability “Flexible arm”. The shield continues to block even from rear attacks.

[b]Blunts.[/b]
Passive ability “Blunt stun”. Chance to stun a target with usual hits.
[b]Knives.[/b]
Passive ability "Insidious blows". Hits from the back increase the chance to deal critical damage.
[b]Axes.[/b]
Passive ability "Axe wounds". Critical hits cause bleeding.

[b]Gathering, Skinning, Lumberjacking, Mining.[/b]
Passive abilities that increase the number of received resources of a certain skill.
Passive abilities that allow you to get some resources, even with unsuccessful mining.
Passive abilities that accelerate the process of extracting resources of a certain skill.
Passive abilities that additionally increase the number of received resources of a certain skill.

[b]Survival, Carpentry, Masonry, Leatherworking, Blacksmithing, Healing, Alchemy.[/b]
Passive abilities that accelerate the creation/construction process for a specific skill.
Passive abilities that allow you to gain experience at failure for Carpentry, Masonry, Blacksmithing.
Passive abilities that increase the lower limit of the quality of items for Carpentry, Masonry, Blacksmithing.

The list of active and passive skills will increase, unique features for each skill will be added!

[b]The next testing phase will begin on March 27![/b] Access for all owners of Conqueror, Hero, Creator packs, and their invited friends.

[h3]What has already been done in the game and will be available at this stage?[/h3]
[list][*] Starting island and Continent with unique locations: forests, cemetery, abandoned mines, church, an old sawmill, and others.
[*] 16 animals and monsters for hunting, including bosses.

[/list]
Gameplay videos can be viewed on our [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCQ9zUVGdlKxLBW0h-mbi75g/videos]YouTube channel.[/url]

[b]No NDA[/b]
Starting from the current stage will be allowed streams, publishing videos, screenshots, reviews, and other materials demonstrating the gameplay of Wild Terra 2: New Lands.

[h3]Dates of the following tests[/h3]
This is only the first stage of the Closed Alpha, the dates of the next stages will be announced during testing.
We plan to launch a [b]new phase every 2-3 weeks[/b], adding new content and fixing bugs.
[b]Closed Beta[/b] testing will begin in May-June 2020, access to it will be given to owners of Settler packs. We plan to launch paid Early Access on Steam ([b]open Beta[/b]) before the end of 2020.

[h3]Support the project, get access and many other rewards[/h3]
The game is being developed thanks to the financial support of the community, without investors and publishers. We will make the game exactly as we and the community wish. However, this approach has another side - we are very limited in funds for development. That is why we need your support.

notes.title: Dev Diaries #4. Seasons, weather, day-night cycle. Impact on the gameplay
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/360ae794b22a7d280f11ce6ffa3ad5a578f44152.png[/img]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/360ae794b22a7d280f11ce6ffa3ad5a578f44152.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/7094b2e0e920d93e4f42c75ed2a652f4571e69da.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/3e70314a4c7c656010bbd0c9b84f7a90fbe67571.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/a6d7dbb480d46a29a8cbf0628edecb1148b2d7eb.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/62dcffe820f6ffee537838366060edf065a21e9f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/0f3c660e3526effe71f0f3d845d56901a844027c.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/94b203dbabbb81f6b9a8b41ab9ac6889923bddd6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/fc59383ea35dde0cf5c8922ed56241c312e37ba1.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/461a128fd186baf8524c88158b0688d2bed5f11e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/58c4e6a5221cb6c31a298c6e0909557fa677e83f.png[/img][/url]

We added new effects for maximum atmosphere immersion: now, with the advent of winter, the game world will be covered by snow, and during the rain, the surfaces will become wet and raindrops will begin to fall from the roofs of houses. But we want to talk about the influence of weather, seasons and time of day on the gameplay Wild Terra 2: New Lands.

In Wild Terra 2: New Lands, weather and changing the time of day is not just a graphic effect, this will have a direct impact on the game. We will be guided by real-world experience and logic in order to add both major and minor changes. Below we will talk about some of our ideas. Please note that we are talking about ideas that are not a priority and may appear in the game much later. And yet, you can offer your ideas in our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/QBb5qJ6]https://discord.gg/QBb5qJ6[/url]

[h2]Night[/h2]
Should I wait until morning, soaking hides for crafted leather and melting all rusted tools, or take a chance and go hunting? Surely you will ask yourself this question repeatedly. At night, your visibility will noticeably worsen, resources will be harder to find, and predator activity will only increase. Why get out of a warm couch? The answer is simple. Some locations and creatures will “come to life” only at night, and also, in the dark, the best conditions for robbery and theft.

[h2]Thunderstorm and fires[/h2]
During a thunderstorm, it is best to stay away from a lonely tree and not use metal weapons. There will also be forest fires in the game.

[h2]Fishing[/h2]
Be prepared for the fact that the rainy windy conditions will hardly be able to catch anything. But on an early sunny morning, your chances will increase many times over.

[h2]Harvest[/h2]
In the old days, people knew well that before the cold weather came, one had to start planning the spring. Until the ground is frozen, you can plant crops such as carrots and onions in order to harvest in the spring. But it is also better to take care of the food in winter in advance and store as much food as possible after the harvest season (do not forget to check stocks sometimes, rodents can be found in warehouses). However, in the hot summer, relaxation is also not possible, crops often need watering. And after rain, the growth of mushrooms and wild crops will accelerate.
